jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Technical Project Manager oversees the project management, planning, execution, tracking, and reporting of Continence Care new product development and lifecycle management projects in accordance with agreed upon scope, timing, and budget. The role requires driving cross functional project and/or program execution through collaboration with various functional groups, including R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Operations and Commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Consistently project manage and deliver high priority projects to ensure completion on time and within the agreed scope and budget.
Be proactive in his/her role within the Core Team. Working with Core Team members to scenario plan and mitigate the potential impact of risks to the project.
With limited supervision, lead project teams to deliver low and medium complexity projects on-time and meeting the agreed target specifications associated with quality and cost.
Support higher complexity projects and be willing to learn and embrace insights from more experienced team members.
Be willing and able to set realistic yet challenging project milestones.
Establish a high-performing team culture.
Establish a core project team and work with across functions to provide a coordinated and collaborative approach to managing assigned New Product Development and Lifecycle Management projects.
Create detailed project plans which clearly identify and sequence the activities needed to successfully complete each project and establish the resources (time, money, capital equipment, etc.) required to complete project activities.
Work within a cross functional team to ensure workstreams are appropriately planned and integrated into master schedules.
Establish effective communication plans ensure appropriate stakeholder management.
Review project schedules and monitor overall progress with senior management and project team members; revise schedules/plan as required and providing timely escalation where appropriate to ensure successful completion.
Manage compliance to both Design Control and Business processes, such as preparation for Gate reviews with core team and ensuring rigorous adherence to IDEAL, the Convatec new product development process.
Set up files to ensure all project information is appropriately documented and archived.
Support the PMO to develop and enhance project management tools, processes, and systems to ensure consistent and efficient ways of working

Skills & Experience:

Minimum of 5 years’ R&D experience within a medical device company, with at least 1 year of project management experience in New Product Development.
Strong proficiency in the use of MS Word, MS Project, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Teams, database software, SAP, MS Outlook, Project Management Cloud Software
Strong communicator; Speak, listen and write in a clear, thorough and timely manner using appropriate and effective communication tools and techniques in-line with an outstanding Project Manager
Leader and team-worker who actively looks to develop themself and others; proactively networks across a complex organizational hierarchy and works cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals and resolve problems

Qualifications/Education:

Advanced Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or Science discipline; MS preferred
Project management certification is preferred (PMP, APM or equivalent)

Travel Requirements

Position may involve travel up to 25% of the time, within the United States and Europe. Most trips will include overnight travel.

Working Conditions:

Primarily remote working with the expectation of travelling to the Global Development Center in Deeside as required for project meetings and workshops.

Beware of scams online or from individuals claiming to represent Convatec

A formal recruitment process is required for all our opportunities prior to any offer of employment. This will include an interview confirmed by an official Convatec email address.

If you receive a suspicious approach over social media, text message, email or phone call about recruitment at Convatec, do not disclose any personal information or pay any fees whatsoever. If you’re unsure, please contact us at careers@Convatec.com.

Equal opportunities

Convatec provides equal employment opportunities for all current employees and applicants for employment. This policy means that no one will be discriminated against because of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship, ancestry, sex, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, genetic predisposing characteristics or any other basis prohibited by law.

Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives

Convatec is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting. Resumes submitted to any Convatec employee by a third party agency and/or search firm without a valid written and signed search agreement, will become the sole property of Convatec. No fee will be paid if a candidate is hired for this position as a result of an unsolicited agency or search firm referral. Thank you.

Already a Convatec employee?

If you are an active employee at Convatec, please do not apply here. Go to the Career Worklet on your Workday home page and View "Convatec Internal Career Site - Find Jobs". Thank you!

About Convatec

Pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch:

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company, focused on solutions for the management of chronic conditions, with leading positions in Advanced Wound Care, Ostomy Care, Continence Care, and Infusion Care. With over 10,000 colleagues, we provide products and services in around 90 countries, united by a promise to be forever caring. Our solutions provide a range of benefits, from infection prevention, treatment for hard to heal wounds, at-risk skin and ulcerated tissue to supporting debilitating conditions, improved patient outcomes and reduced care costs. Convatec's revenues in 2025 were over $2 billion. The company is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index (LSE:CTEC). To learn more please visit: http://www.convatecgroup.com.

Project Manager - Remote, US

ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

As a Clinical Project Manager at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and coordinate project activities, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

What You Will Do

Your focus will be on coordinating clinical project and program management delivery, resolving issues, and developing team capability.

Key Responsibilities Include

Developing and managing detailed clinical project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful project delivery.
Leading cross-functional clinical project teams, coordinating efforts to meet project objectives, and facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
Monitoring project progress, identifying potential risks and issues, and implementing strategies to address challenges and keep projects on track.
Engaging with stakeholders to manage expectations, provide updates, and ensure alignment with project goals and organizational objectives.
Preparing and presenting project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior management and other stakeholders.

Your Profile

You will have solid clinical project and program management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor's degree in project management, business, or a related field is preferred, with significant experience in project management and team leadership.
Proven track record of successfully managing projects from inception to completion, with a focus on delivering results within scope, time, and budget constraints.
Respiratory or Ophthalmology indication experience preferred
Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively manage project teams and prioritize tasks.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies, with certifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 being advantageous.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and adaptable, with a commitment to achieving project goals and driving continuous improvement.
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 30%)

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

Job Description

eDiscovery Project Manager

Drive Operational Excellence

At Ashurst Perkins Coie US LLP

, our people are our greatest asset. We’re looking for a collaborative, detail-oriented eDiscovery Project Manager to join our team and help deliver an exceptional employee experience.

In this role, the eDiscovery Project Manager

is a trusted advisor who delivers strategic, technology-driven solutions that support case teams, clients, and matter success. This role leads matter management and applies innovative legal technologies to streamline workflows, solve complex challenges, and advance case objectives. Working collaboratively with Senior Project Managers, Consulting Managers, Practice Attorneys, Project Coordinators, Data Transformation Analysts, and legal professionals across the firm, the Project Manager drives efficient, client-focused outcomes through expertise, partnership, and innovation.

What You’ll Do

Advise legal teams and clients on the strategic use of legal technologies, including AI, to solve complex legal challenges and enhance matter outcomes.
Serve as the primary NewLaw contact, managing matters from initiation through successful delivery.
Lead multiple projects simultaneously, balancing priorities, timelines, budgets, risks, and evolving scope.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners supporting forensics, analytics, review, trial readiness, and other litigation services.
Apply deep expertise in legal technology platforms, including Relativity, DISCO, and Everchron, to deliver efficient, high-quality solutions.
Oversee database design, data transformation, document productions, and other critical matter management activities.
Define technical requirements, manage deliverables, ensure quality assurance, and validate production accuracy, including privilege, redactions, conflict coding, and family relationships.
Communicate proactively with stakeholders on project status, milestones, risks, costs, and scope changes.
Stay current on emerging legal technologies and champion best practices and continuous improvement across the firm.
Support business development initiatives, including client presentations, and maintain availability to meet firm and client needs.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree and at least 3 years of related work experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be substituted.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrates expertise in legal practice technologies, including Generative AI, with exceptional project and matter management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines.
An innovative problem-solver and trusted client partner, this individual communicates effectively, exercises sound judgment, and takes initiative with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in Relativity and/or DISCO, along with the ability to quickly master emerging litigation technologies, is essential.
Prior experience in litigation or e-discovery project management is strongly preferred.

Why Join Ashurst Perkins Coie?

Join a collaborative, high-performing Project Management team where your expertise will help shape the employee experience across our global organization. In this role, if you are passionate about delivering exceptional service and making a lasting impact, you will find meaningful opportunities to grow your career while helping create an outstanding experience for our people.

This position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, 401(k) plan, medical, dental, and vision insurance, accrued paid time off plan starting at 20 days annually, personal medical and parental leave, up to 10 paid holidays, and family care benefits. More information regarding benefits and programs may be found here .

jobs.description:
Company Description
CMPLTE AI is an enterprise AI integration and implementation company focused on helping organizations move AI from pilot projects into production environments. The team connects AI platforms to core business systems such as ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, documents, data sources, APIs, internal applications, and operational workflows. CMPLTE AI partners both with enterprises implementing AI within existing operations and with AI technology companies that need an implementation partner for their enterprise customers. The company’s team brings deep experience across SaaS, AI, consulting, enterprise software, industrial operations, systems integration, workflow automation, and production deployment, enabling practical, results-oriented AI solutions for clients.
Role Description
The Implementation Manager is a full-time remote role responsible for leading end-to-end implementation of AI solutions for enterprise clients. This role coordinates discovery and requirements gathering, translates business needs into technical implementation plans, and manages project timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations. The Implementation Manager collaborates closely with client teams and internal engineers to configure integrations, oversee testing, and ensure successful deployment into production environments. Day-to-day activities include managing implementation roadmaps, monitoring risks and issues, facilitating status meetings, documenting processes and workflows, and driving continuous improvement based on client feedback and performance data. The role also supports best practices for change management and user adoption to maximize value from implemented AI solutions.
Qualifications

Experience managing implementation projects for SaaS, AI, enterprise software, or systems integration, including requirements discovery, planning, and execution.
Background working with ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, APIs, data platforms, or workflow automation tools in an implementation or operations context.
Strong project management skills, including stakeholder communication, risk management, scheduling, and documentation of processes and technical details.
Ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements and collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and client operations teams.
Comfort working with data-driven solutions and AI products; familiarity with production deployment practices and integration patterns is highly beneficial.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment, prioritize multiple initiatives, and maintain high attention to detail.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, Business) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in consulting, enterprise implementations, or industrial operations is a plus, as is prior work with change management and user training.

to join our Power Transmission & Distribution team on the BTNO project in Assington, Suffolk.

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for the safe, sustainable and successful delivery of Overhead Line projects from planning and design through to commissioning and handover. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage key stakeholder relationships, and ensure projects are delivered to programme, budget and quality requirements.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role on a nationally significant infrastructure project while working with one of the UK's leading construction and infrastructure organisations

What you'll be doing

Lead the delivery of OHL projects from inception through to completion.
Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to required quality standards.
Manage project resources, programmes, risks, opportunities and commercial performance.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders and supply chain partners.
Lead project reviews, reporting activities and governance processes.

Manage subcontractors and coordinate procurement activities.
Lead and develop high-performing project teams through coaching, mentoring and effective leadership.
Ensure robust planning, change control and project controls are in place.
Oversee project budgets, contract compliance and commercial outcomes.

Experience of working on a variety of project types
Able to demonstrate a track record of project delivery
In depth understanding and practical experience of standard forms of contracts
Proficient in commercial/project management communications
Experience in implementing safe systems of work
Able to communicate effectively both verbal and written with all levels of the organisation
Communicate new concepts and ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Effective team management skills which empower, influence & inspire others to build effective teams. Providing mentoring and support to members of the team where required
Good knowledge of performance evaluation techniques and key metrics
Record of a solution-based approach to problem solving
Ability to see the business vision and inspire this shared vision amongst the team
Discuss ideas and plans competently and with confidence
Sponsor and promote project diversity and inclusion
Recognise and drive personal development with a learning mindset
Member of a professional management body i.e. APM

Formal qualification in project management or equivalent experience
CSCS and SMSTS or Equivalent

Day in, day out, our teams deliver some of the UK’s most ambitious, exciting and meaningful projects; developing, building and maintaining the vital infrastructure that supports national economies and strengthens communities.

jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

August Robotics is an international startup building and deploying autonomous robots that help businesses complete complex, repetitive, and labor-intensive tasks more efficiently. Our construction robotics business is growing rapidly, with our robots being deployed on active construction sites across the US and internationally. We are looking for a driven, adaptable Project Manager to help us successfully plan, coordinate, and execute these deployments as we scale.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a driven and adaptable Project Manager to help coordinate and execute our growing robotics deployment program. You will manage projects from planning through execution, working remotely between regular visits to active construction jobsites. You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and our external project management partners to keep projects organized, aligned, and moving forward.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

Manage robotic deployment projects from planning through execution.
Travel to construction jobsites approximately 8–10 days per month to manage deployments onsite.
Coordinate closely with customers, internal teams, site teams, and external project management partners.
Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Communicate clear plans, timelines, responsibilities, and project updates.
Adapt quickly as jobsite conditions, schedules, and customer needs change.
Build and improve processes as our deployment program scales.
Support and mentor additional Project Managers as the team grows.

YOUR SKILLS

What we are looking for: 5+ years of professional work experience.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Excellent organization and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and creating structure where needed.
Flexible and adaptable when plans change.
Strong relationship-building skills with customers, partners, and teammates.

REQUIREMENTS
:
You must live within one hour of a major airport.
Willingness to travel approximately 8–10 days per month, primarily domestically.
Comfortable working on active construction jobsites.
Ability to obtain OSHA 30 certification, with company support.
Ability to pass a OneSource Level 2+ background check and drug screening.
You do not need a background in robotics or mechanics.
We are looking for someone with strong ownership, energy, judgment, and the ability to drive results in a fast-moving environment.

WHY AUGUST ROBOTICS?

Real-world impact: Help deploy robotics technology on active construction sites.
High ownership: Take responsibility for projects from planning through execution.
Build as we grow: Help shape the processes and systems behind a rapidly scaling deployment program.
Global exposure: Work across customers, partners, and teams in the US and internationally.

You will maintain program momentum, unblock technical and cross-functional teams, and regularly deliver high-level BI and performance updates to executive leadership.

Drive Executive & Business Updates: Establish clear reporting cadences for leadership, translating AI model performance, traveler engagement trends, and BI dashboard metrics into executive-ready status updates.

Deliver Operational Momentum: Maintain project management rigor across data pipelines, predictive search features, dynamic pricing models, and AI support systems—tracking milestones and holding dependencies accountable.
Translate Data into Strategy: Partner with CX and Product leadership to convert traveler behavior data and BI reporting into actionable operational changes that reduce friction across the booking and trip lifecycle.
Unblock Technical & Organizational Friction: Proactively identify bottlenecks in data availability, BI tool integrations, or cross-team alignment, delivering clear resolution paths before project schedules slip.

Qualifications

Experience: 4–6 years of program management experience leading technical AI, business intelligence, or data strategy initiatives.
BI & AI Competency: Strong command of business intelligence frameworks, visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau), SQL, and practical understanding of AI/ML lifecycles (including Generative AI and predictive modeling).
Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to manage complex technical roadmaps involving data engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Executive Communication: Exceptional talent for synthesizing data-heavy technical concepts into compelling, structured updates for non-technical executives.
Domain Empathy: Deep interest in online travel, marketplace dynamics, and traveler journey optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in travel tech, e-commerce marketplaces, or consumer-facing digital platforms.
Certifications in program management (PMP, CSM) or advanced credentials in Business Intelligence / Data Strategy.

Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses

Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Within SSOE’s Tool Install division, we specialize in high-tech Tool Installation design, offering top-tier design and engineering services to a diverse array of clients and markets. Our team is composed of highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who excel across various disciplines. We pride ourselves on our cross-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting-edge techniques and state-of-the-art software, we deliver industry-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one.

SSOE is seeking a Project Manager to join our Tool Install design team. This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned professional with a strong background in managing complex design-build tool installation and hook-up projects within high-tech semiconductor (fab) environments. You will lead cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on scope, schedule, and the designs follow the project and client specifications and standards. The projects this person will be engaged on will encompass a variety of unique challenges and innovative solutions due to their varying sizes, scopes, and complexities. You will partner with our multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, and designers, to deliver exceptional results for our clients. This role offers the opportunity to lead and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for some of the world's leading technological companies.

AI and Innovation

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities

Identify, understand, and manage the scope of work, schedule, and budget of various design packages.
Manage the end-to-end execution of tool install design projects, from initial equipment specifications and utility matrix development through to final hook-up, commissioning, and client handover.
Develop and manage detailed tool-level installation schedules, ensuring critical path milestones are met to support the client’s "First Tool" and "Ready for Equipment" (RFE) dates.
Act as a point of contact between the design team, trade contractors, and client tool owners to resolve conflicts regarding space management, utility routing, and point-of-connection (POC) details.
Maintain strict control over project budgets, managing change orders related to tool configuration shifts and ensuring procurement of long-lead infrastructure components aligns with the installation sequence.
Enforce EHS standards and cleanroom protocols, ensuring that all installation activities are performed without compromising the integrity of the facility or the safety of the personnel.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with utility capacity, seismic bracing, and vibration isolation requirements for sensitive process equipment.
Follows established change management procedures to document and receive authorization for project change orders in a timely manner.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging lessons learned to optimize project delivery methodologies and enhance client satisfaction.
Offer mentorship and training to fellow Project Managers, sharing insights on resolving intricate design challenges in high technology and industrial design projects, both at SSOE and client sites.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related technical discipline preferred).
Demonstrated project management experience, with a significant portion focused on the design of industrial, advanced technology, or high-tech manufacturing facilities (e.g., semiconductor fabrication plants, data centers, pharmaceutical manufacturing).
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is highly desired.
Demonstrated proficiency with project scheduling software, such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or similar. Experience with resource loading and critical path analysis is essential.
Demonstrated success managing cross-cultural, cross-time-zone project teams, adept at tailoring communication styles and governance to diverse audiences.
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts effectively with various stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions.
Ability to perform field verifications and site walks in industrial environments, including the ability to navigate construction sites and potentially access elevated areas.

Compensation & Benefits

SSOE offers a competitive total compensation package designed to support and empower our employees and their families.

Salary: $115,000 – $145,000 per year, commensurate with location, education, and depth of experience.
Incentives: Leadership bonus program and ownership investment opportunities. We believe the people who build SSOE should share in its success.
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance; employer-paid life insurance; and wellness program support.
Retirement: 401(k) plan with company match.
Professional Growth: Dedicated professional development funding, PE licensure and certification exam support, conference attendance, and structured career advancement programs.
Time Off: Generous paid time off (PTO) policy plus paid holidays.
Work-Life Balance: SSOE actively supports flexible scheduling within project commitments and a culture that genuinely respects your time outside the office.

Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and engineering excellence. If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward-thinking team.

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Electrification – Power Transformers | Stafford, United Kingdom

Do you want to lead complex, high-value projects that help power the future of energy transmission around the world?

GE Vernova is looking for an experienced Lead Project Manager to join our HVDC Power Transformers team based in Stafford, United Kingdom.

GE Vernova – The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Electrification

Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.

Let’s Talk About the Role

As Lead Project Manager, you will take ownership of complex, high-value HVDC transformer projects from project handover through to final delivery and customer acceptance.

You will manage multiple projects or transformer packages concurrently, with accountability for their operational and financial performance. Working within a global matrix organisation, you will lead cross-functional teams spanning engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, logistics and other key functions.

You will bring these teams together to deliver projects safely and in accordance with agreed quality, cost and schedule commitments. As a trusted point of contact for customers, you will balance commercial rigour with technical delivery, helping to protect project outcomes while strengthening customer relationships and GE Vernova’s reputation for excellence.

This is a project leadership position without formal direct reports. Your success will depend on your ability to influence, coordinate and lead multidisciplinary project resources across the wider organisation.

How You Will Make a Difference

Take ownership of HVDC transformer projects from formal project handover through to delivery and customer acceptance.
Lead multiple projects or equipment packages concurrently, establishing clear plans, priorities, milestones and accountabilities.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, logistics and other supporting functions.
Manage project financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, costs and margin within the assigned scope.
Develop and maintain project schedules, delivery plans and contingency or recovery actions.
Monitor project scope and contractual commitments, ensuring that changes and their commercial or delivery implications are understood and appropriately managed.
Drive the effective management of risks and opportunities, identifying potential issues early and implementing suitable mitigation actions.
Act as a key point of contact for customers, maintaining clear communication and building strong, lasting relationships.
Facilitate project and gate reviews, ensuring that actions, decisions and accountabilities are clearly documented and followed through.
Provide accurate and timely reporting on project progress, costs, risks and overall performance.
Work with internal teams, customers and suppliers to resolve complex technical, commercial and delivery challenges.
Promote a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance and continuous improvement throughout project execution.
Capture lessons learned and use them to strengthen future project delivery.

Special Role Requirements

Occasional travel, including international travel, may be required to support project delivery and customer engagement.

Skills for Success

You will be a confident, organised communicator with a strong record of delivering complex projects. You will bring:

Significant experience managing complex, high-value, customer-facing engineering, equipment or manufacturing projects.
Experience taking ownership of projects from contract or internal handover through to delivery and customer acceptance.
Strong financial and commercial awareness, including experience managing project budgets, costs, forecasts and financial performance.
Practical knowledge of project risk, opportunity, change and issue management.
Experience coordinating and leading multidisciplinary teams within a matrix organisation.
The ability to manage multiple projects, work packages or competing priorities concurrently.
Strong customer and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to communicate across technical, commercial and senior-leadership audiences.
The ability to analyse complex information, exercise sound judgement and drive issues through to resolution.
Strong written and spoken English; additional language skills would be advantageous.
Confidence using project-management, reporting and documentation systems.

A degree in Electrical Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline would be advantageous. However, we are most interested in your overall project-delivery experience, professional achievements and practical expertise.

Experience delivering transformers, HVDC systems, power-transmission infrastructure or other high-value engineered equipment would be particularly valuable. We would also welcome relevant experience gained within other technically complex sectors.

A recognised project-management qualification, such as APM, PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent certification, would also be advantageous.

Where and How You’ll Work

This is a permanent position based at our Stafford facility.

We operate a hybrid working model, with an expectation that you will normally work from the Stafford site three days per week and from home for the remaining two days.

The position follows standard business hours and is not a shift-based role. Occasional travel may be required, although this is expected to be limited.

Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate-change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, join us and be the difference. Together, we have the Energy to Change the World.

We’re Determined to Be the Best Place to Grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you with the tools to navigate and shape a career journey that supports a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you throughout your journey.

We also prioritise fair pay, performance-based rewards and wellbeing programmes for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can continue evolving while sustainability remains at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we help inspire others to grow, succeed and raise the bar for everyone.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to supporting disadvantaged groups while providing equal opportunities for GE Vernova colleagues and applicants alike.

Join us at GE Vernova, where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

jobs.description:
Help us tackle the growing wildfire crisis with the latest advancements in AI and IoT

Who We Are

The challenge:
Every minute matters in wildfire response. As climate change increases the frequency and intensity of wildfires—with longer fire seasons, drier fuels, and more extreme weather—new ignitions can spread rapidly, putting communities, critical infrastructure, and ecosystems at risk. Today, many wildfires are first reported by members of the public
, meaning it can take valuable time to detect a fire, confirm its location and size, and mobilize responders
. Fire agencies
need faster, more reliable ways to detect, verify, and pinpoint new ignitions so they can respond quickly and prevent small fires from becoming catastrophic events.

About Pano AI:
Pano AI is the leader in AI-powered wildfire detection and intelligence, helping fire professionals detect, respond to, and contain wildfires faster and more safely. Our platform combines advanced hardware, software, artificial intelligence, satellite imagery, and other data sources to provide real-time situational awareness and actionable intelligence. Using a network of ultra-high-definition, 360-degree cameras positioned across high vantage points, Pano AI delivers a real-time view of wildfire activity, enabling faster, more informed decision-making when every second counts.

We are a team of more than 175 people working in a hybrid-remote environment across North America and Australia
, with headquarters in San Francisco. Our customers include government agencies, utilities, insurers, and private landowners
who rely on Pano AI to help protect people, property, and natural landscapes. Pano AI currently serves customers across the United States, Australia, and Canada
, monitoring more than 50 million acres worldwide.

Our values are part of everything we do at Pano AI. They guide how we work together, how we serve our customers, and how we approach our mission.

Impact:
As we scale our business, we grow our impact—enabling emergency managers to protect people, infrastructure, and the environment from devastating wildfires.

Service:
We serve those who serve, and the teammates beside us.

Trust:
We earn trust through integrity, accountability, and an obsession with quality so that our partners can rely on us.

Excellence and Speed:
We produce exceptional work quickly because our mission demands both precision and urgency.

Innovation:
We apply cutting-edge technology to what we build and how we work.

Our work has been recognized by Fast Company as one of the Top 10 Most Innovative AI Companies in 2023 and one of the World's Most Innovative Companies in 2026, ranking #1 in Sustainability. We have also been named to TIME's list of the 100 Most Influential Companies of 2025 and recognized by MIT Technology Review as one of the top climate technology companies to watch.

Backed by $89 million in funding from leading investors including Giant Ventures, Liberty Mutual Ventures, Tokio Marine Future Fund, Congruent Ventures, Initialized Capital, Salesforce Ventures, and T-Mobile Ventures, we're building technology that helps communities around the world become more resilient to wildfire. Learn more at www.pano.ai
.

The Role

Pano AI is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of complex cross-functional programs across our engineering, product, and operations teams. As a Senior TPM, you will be the connective tissue between our squads—ensuring that ambitious technical initiatives ship on time, risks are surfaced early, and every team has what they need to move fast. You will work across our Software, Embedded, and Hardware teams to drive programs from discovery through delivery, and play a key role in maturing our program management practices as we scale.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the heart of Pano’s engineering organization. You will partner directly with engineering leads, product managers, and design—and have a direct line to senior leadership on program status and risk. If you are energized by bringing order to complexity, thrive in fast-moving startup environments, and care deeply about building technology that saves lives, we’d love to meet you.

What you'll do

Own end-to-end program management for complex, multi-team technical initiatives—from scoping and planning through execution, launch, and retrospective
Partner with engineering leads, product managers, and designers to define program milestones, map dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress, risks, and decisions
Drive sprint planning, quarterly roadmap planning, and OKR processes, ensuring teams have clear priorities, realistic timelines, and well-defined success criteria
Build and maintain program dashboards, status reports, and roadmap views that provide leadership and cross-functional partners with real-time visibility into delivery health
Identify and resolve blockers proactively—driving escalations, facilitating decisions, and removing friction across teams before they become schedule threats
Lead cross-functional working groups and recurring program syncs, ensuring the right people are engaged and every meeting drives toward a clear, documented outcome
Support the engineering organization in building scalable processes, tooling, and ceremonies as we grow from 150 to 300+ people
Collaborate with external partners—including fire agencies, government entities, and utility companies—to coordinate program dependencies and joint deliverables
Champion engineering team health: track capacity, flag burnout risks, and advocate for sustainable pacing without sacrificing velocity

What you'll bring

7+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related field at a fast-paced technology company or startup
Proven track record of managing large-scale, cross-functional technical programs with multiple concurrent workstreams, competing priorities, and diverse stakeholders
Strong technical fluency—comfortable engaging with engineering teams on system architecture, APIs, platform integrations, and sprint-level planning

Exceptional communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical topics for executive and non-technical audiences, and to write crisp status reports and decision documents

Content & Studio Engineering builds and operates the technology that powers Netflix’s content journey from pitch to post. Our team delivers robust infrastructure, media management, and workflow solutions for everything from evaluating pitches and managing deals to orchestrating petabytes of production media, scheduling releases, and supporting post-production processes. We enable data-informed decision-making for content executives, support global studio operations, and pioneer new workflows with Generative AI - all while ensuring seamless integration across Netflix and its subsidiaries.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager with a background in studio or media tech infrastructure or Generative AI/ML platforms to drive high-impact, cross-functional programs. This role requires strong collaboration with product, engineering, design, data science, and senior leadership to execute complex, strategic technology programs across the studio.

Responsibilities

Lead multiple complex, cross-functional technical programs focused on foundational studio infrastructure, including hardware provisioning (workstations, render nodes), cloud tenant setup (compute, storage, network), and large-scale data migration initiatives.
Provide deep domain expertise to form technical strategies for migrating and modernizing studio production environments, including large datasets across various storage and cloud solutions.
Drive and manage the technical integration of third-party creative and infrastructure software onto Netflix's corporate platforms.
Scope and lead the execution of Generative AI/ML initiatives, working with engineering and data science partners to identify high-value use cases and productionize new AI platform capabilities, such as access to advanced LLM/APIs.
Drive engagement with cross-functional partners, work to decompose requirements into technical execution plans with measurable milestones, effectively optimize scope and schedule, manage cross-functional dependencies, and proactively manage risks around Day 1 readiness for complex tech integrations.
Craft clear communication of progress toward goals, reporting status to stakeholders and leadership, translating complex technical challenges into clear business implications.

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of Technical program management experience.
Must have domain experience in Studio Technology Infrastructure, Media Production Pipelines, or Generative AI/Machine Learning Platform delivery.
Proven experience driving large-scale software and infrastructure projects, managing the definition of technical strategies, and building long-term scalable solutions.
Deep understanding and point of view on the application of Generative AI/ML to creative and production workflows.
Experience orchestrating multiple programs with many moving parts and building partnerships across cross-functional teams.
Able to identify gaps in solutions, evaluate technical approaches, and weigh product vs. technology tradeoffs.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate business impact and technical constraints tailored to the audience.
Ability to drive progress independently on new or undefined initiatives by quickly establishing structure and clear direction.
Ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams, including collaboration across US and European time zones.
Exemplify the Netflix culture by understanding, advocating, and demonstrating its values.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing programs involving large-scale data migration, cloud infrastructure (AWS, CoreWeave, GCP), and high-performance computing/rendering environments.

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell is seeking a seasoned Senior Staff Program Manager to lead the delivery of next-generation semiconductor solutions built on industry-leading process technologies. This role drives execution across highly complex, cross-functional programs addressing some of the most demanding challenges in AI, wired and wireless communications, and critical infrastructure markets.

As part of the Photonic Fabric Hardware Engineering Program Management team, you will lead end-to-end program execution for complex silicon design initiatives, with a strong focus on design engineering delivery and business outcomes. This role partners closely with cross-functional engineering, product, and operations teams to drive the development of silicon-based subsystems that are foundational to multiple Business Unit programs. What You Can Expect

Own end-to-end program execution across silicon development stages — architecture, RTL, DV, DFT, PD, FW, post-silicon characterization, and mass production ramp.
Drive tapeout readiness, milestone tracking, and sign-off across all engineering disciplines; manage silicon bring-up, errata, and corrective actions to closure.
Manage foundry, OSAT, IP, and third-party vendor relationships; negotiate SOWs, track commitments, and escalate risks proactively.
Develop and maintain program plans (WBS, schedules, risk registers); lead POR/PSM planning sessions and executive program reviews.
Work across a large matrix organization to align engineering execution with business unit objectives; drive cross-functional issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

What We're Looking For

BS in Electrical/Computer Engineering or related field (10–15 yrs exp); MS preferred (8-10 yrs exp).
7+ years of program management experience in the semiconductor industry, driving SoC/HW programs from definition to mass production.
Solid working knowledge of the full silicon development flow: RTL, DV, DFT, PD, FW/SW integration, post-silicon characterization, and packaging.
General familiarity with TSMC advanced node flows (N5/N4/N3/N2+) — process milestones, yield ramp, and PCN management.
Strong vendor and subcontractor management experience (foundry, OSAT, IP suppliers).
Exceptional communication, risk management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
PMP certification preferred. Lives the Marvell Core Behaviors.

132,610 - 198,600, $ per annum

Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. Lead project reviews, coordinate witness testing, and manage escalations to resolution

Manage financial performance, including payment milestones, invoicing alignment, and cash flow tracking against contractual deliverables
Lead risk and change management, proactively identifying technical, schedule, and contractual exposures — particularly during commissioning, energization, and acceptance phases
Coordinate cross-functional teams (engineering, controls, software, and client stakeholders) to ensure alignment with contractual and technical requirements

Strong risk management, change control, and contract interpretation capabilities
Ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes, not just reporting

Experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, or microgrid/power management projects
Familiarity with commissioning processes (L1–L5, integrated systems testing) in critical environments
Exposure to utility interconnection processes and witness testing
Experience working with hyperscale clients (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta) or similar standards
Background in power systems, SCADA, EPMS, ADMS, or automation delivery
Experience with project tracking and reporting tools such as JIRA or Power BI
PMP or equivalent certification
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects or readiness to grow into a program/portfolio leadership role

About the Role:

At Ferrero, protecting our people, our brands and our business is fundamental to how we operate.

As Security Manager UK&I, you will lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of our security strategy across the UK and Ireland, working closely with Group Security and senior stakeholders across the business. With a remit spanning our manufacturing sites, offices, warehouses, Head Office and wider business operations, this is a broad and influential security leadership role.

Taking a holistic and risk-based approach, you will be responsible for helping protect our people, physical assets, goods, critical processes and organisational know-how, balancing effective risk mitigation with commercial awareness and operational practicality.

This is much more than a traditional site security role. Your remit will span security intelligence, physical and logistical security, executive protection, travel security, incident and crisis management, investigations, due diligence, security training, and threat and risk assessment.

As a trusted adviser to UK&I leadership, you will assess an evolving risk landscape, ensure emerging threats and vulnerabilities are understood and appropriately escalated, and translate complex security risks into proportionate, practical solutions for the business.

Main Responsibilities:

You will lead the implementation and continuous improvement of Ferrero's Security Management System across UK&I, ensuring alignment with Group standards while responding to the specific risk profile and operational requirements of the local business.

You will develop and maintain security, emergency response and crisis management plans, alongside programmes covering physical security, information protection, incident management, travel security and executive protection.

A key part of your role will be monitoring and assessing the external threat landscape, including crime, terrorism, workplace violence, geopolitical and travel risks, natural or man-made disruption and emerging security threats, translating intelligence into appropriate action for the business.

You will lead and support sensitive internal investigations involving matters such as theft, fraud, conflicts of interest, bribery, loss of assets and unauthorised disclosure of proprietary information, working with relevant internal functions and external authorities where appropriate.

You will oversee physical security projects from initial risk assessment and technical requirements through to implementation, coordinating internal stakeholders, suppliers and contractors and ensuring effective management of scope, timelines, budgets and delivery.

Working closely with Supply Chain, you will support an effective logistics security programme designed to protect raw materials and finished goods across domestic and international movements.

You will manage UK&I security CAPEX and OPEX budgets
, including forecasting, cost control and variance management, ensuring investment decisions remain aligned with identified risks and business priorities.

Building strong relationships will be fundamental to the role. You will partner with UK&I leadership, Plant Management, Supply Chain, P&O, Risk Management, Finance and Group Security, while also maintaining appropriate external networks with law enforcement, intelligence and security organisations.

You will also lead security awareness and training initiatives, strengthening security capability across the organisation and ensuring our people understand the role they play in protecting themselves, their colleagues and the business.

About You:

You will be an established security professional with experience operating across a complex corporate, multi-site or similarly demanding environment, bringing the credibility and judgement required to influence at senior level.

You will have strong knowledge across areas including corporate and physical security, threat and risk assessment, investigations, crisis and incident management, and security intelligence, with the ability to understand how different areas of security risk connect across an organisation.

Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, you will be equally confident advising senior leaders on significant or emerging risks and ensuring security programmes, controls and projects are successfully delivered operationally.

You will bring strong judgement, integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive matters, alongside the ability to remain calm, assess information quickly and make sound decisions in complex or rapidly developing situations.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills are essential, together with the ability to build effective relationships across different functions, locations and levels of seniority.

You will also bring strong project and financial management capability, ideally including experience managing security suppliers, significant physical security projects and CAPEX/OPEX budgets.

If you are a security leader who combines strong technical expertise with commercial judgement, stakeholder influence and the ability to turn risk insight into action, this is an opportunity to shape security capability and resilience across Ferrero UK&I and help us continue to protect what matters most – our people, our business and our brands.

Mission Technologies’ Global Security (GS) group comprises live, virtual, constructive (LVC) solutions; fleet sustainment; nuclear and environmental; and Australia business.

As a trusted partner to our military customers, HII designs, develops and operates the largest LVC enterprise that prepares warfighters for cross-domain battle. With advanced technologies to enable mission readiness, HII understands that preparation requires full coordination—not readiness in piece-parts.

For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants and aircraft carriers—HII ensures a high state of readiness.

HII supports the Department of Energy’s national security mission through the management and operation of its sites, as well as the safe cleanup of legacy waste across the country. HII meets clients’ toughest nuclear and environmental challenges.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

Mission Technologies, a division of HII, is seeking an experienced Industrial Security Analyst to support ongoing SCIF/SAPF renovation, infrastructure modernization, and Protected Distribution System (PDS) integration initiatives at the Joint Integrated Test and Training Center – Nellis (JITTC-N) supporting the 31 CTS at Nellis AFB, NV.

This position will serve as the primary Site Security Manager (SSM) and Construction Security representative for renovation and infrastructure projects associated with the JITTC-N campus mission environments. The role will directly support phased modernization efforts involving facility upgrades, secure communications infrastructure, PDS implementation, and transition toward co-use SCIF/SAPF environments in accordance with ICD/ICS 705 requirements. The selected candidate will work in close coordination with the Physical Security Lead for construction security synchronization, accreditation support, and integration of physical security requirements throughout all phases of renovation and modernization activities, while reporting directly to the Physical Security Lead for overall project execution, milestone coordination, and operational integration efforts and will support synchronization between Industrial Security, Physical Security, Civil Engineering, Communications, Program Management, Facilities, and operational stakeholders to ensure security compliance is maintained throughout all phases of construction and modernization efforts.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Serve as the Site Security Manager (SSM) for SCIF/SAPF renovation, modernization, and classified construction activities.
Coordinate closely with the Physical Security Lead to support construction security oversight, project synchronization, milestone tracking, and accreditation-related activities, project execution, renovation coordination, operational integration efforts, deliverables, and milestone status updates.
Maintain and enforce Construction Security Plans (CSPs) supporting ICD 705 compliance requirements.
Support planning and coordination efforts associated with Protected Distribution System (PDS) implementation and secure infrastructure modernization.
Apply working knowledge of CNSSI No. 7003 requirements related to Protected Distribution Systems (PDS), secure transmission pathways, inspection requirements, and physical protection standards for classified communications infrastructure.
Review project drawings, Statements of Work (SOW), facility layouts, and construction packages impacting classified environments.
Support accreditation documentation efforts associated with ICD 705 upgrades, co-use facility requirements, and phased construction activities.
Assist with development and coordination of SOPs, interim operational procedures, and risk mitigation strategies during active renovation and infrastructure integration efforts.
Monitor classified construction activities and ensure compliance with applicable ICD/ICS 705, CNSSI 7003, NISPOM, and customer-specific security requirements.
Conduct construction security oversight, document security incidents/violations, maintain construction security records, and support inspection activities.
Participate in project meetings, facility walkthroughs, site surveys, risk assessments, milestone tracking, and cross-functional project synchronization efforts.
Support long-term campus modernization initiatives involving secure communications pathways, classified infrastructure integration, and co-use SCIF/SAPF accreditation strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

6 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
Specialized Training Requirement: The selected candidate will be required to complete an approved Site Security Manager (SSM) training plan to bring the member up to the fully required specialized construction security experience level within one (1) year of hire.
Client requirements: Minimum 5+ years of Industrial Security experience supporting DoD/DoW or Intelligence Community programs.
Demonstrated experience supporting Intelligence Community Directive (ICD)/ Intelligence Community Standard (ICS) 705 Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF),/Special Access Program Facilities (SAPF), construction, renovation, or accreditation projects.
Working knowledge of Committee on National Security Systems Instruction (CNSSI) No. 7003 Protected Distribution System (PDS) requirements.
Experience developing or managing Construction Security Plans (CSPs).
Working knowledge of construction processes, infrastructure modernization efforts, facility renovations, or Civil Engineering project environments.
Familiarity with project drawings, facility modification packages, and construction coordination processes.
Knowledge of National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), ICD/ICS 705, and classified facility compliance requirements.
Experience coordinating with AO, PSO, CTTA, Civil Engineering, Communications, Physical Security, Facilities, and project stakeholders.
Ability to manage competing priorities within active operational and construction environments.
Active Top Secret clearance required.

Preferred Requirements

TS/SCI eligibility preferred.
Prior experience serving as a Site Security Manager (SSM) or Construction Security representative.
ICD 705 SSM training/course completion preferred.
Experience supporting Protected Distribution System (PDS) implementation or secure communications infrastructure projects.
Experience supporting co-use facilities or phased accreditation environments.
Strong organizational, communication, documentation, and project coordination skills.

Coordinate with Construction on security system requirements for new builds and other projects.
Work with Purchasing and vendors to identify and obtain equipment needed for installations, repairs, and system maintenance.
Review blueprints, diagrams, submittals, specifications, schematics, software documentation, and installation manuals to guide system work.
Support pre-wire work for alarm, video surveillance, and access control systems.
Ensure work follows applicable safety requirements and established procedures.
Maintain effective coordination with Switch teams, customers, vendors, and subcontractors throughout security system work.

You set clear priorities and follow through on commitments.
You make practical decisions when technical, schedule, or resource issues arise.
You communicate technical information clearly and include the details others need to make decisions.
You support your team while holding people accountable for safe, reliable work.

You follow established safety and operating procedures in mission-critical environments.

What You’ll Bring

Experience with access control, video management, biometric access, alarm, intercom, or related security platforms.

Ability to read and apply blueprints, diagrams, submittals, specifications, schematics, software documentation, and installation manuals.
Experience with pre-wire installation for alarm, video surveillance, or access control systems.
High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience.
Valid driver’s license.

Ability to wear required personal protective equipment when working in field or warehouse environments.
Ability to complete any additional background checks or drug screenings required for customer-specific deployments.

At CGI, you'll lead the successful delivery of complex projects that help transform critical services across government and secure environments. You'll manage project plans, governance, budgets and delivery teams while working closely with clients, suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project execution. Your leadership will help identify and manage risks, resolve issues and maintain effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.

You'll also contribute to a culture of delivery excellence by promoting best practice, supporting continuous improvement and building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Working across multidisciplinary teams, you'll play a key role in delivering projects that provide lasting value to our clients while mentoring colleagues and helping strengthen CGI's project delivery capability.

Key responsibilities

Lead & deliver complex projects and programmes from initiation through to closure
Develop & maintain project plans, schedules, budgets and governance documentation
Manage & mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies and change requests
Coordinate & lead multidisciplinary delivery teams, suppliers and client stakeholders
Monitor & report project progress, finances, milestones and resource requirements
Ensure & maintain compliance with governance, security and quality standards
Advise & support senior stakeholders with delivery decisions and escalations
Drive & embed continuous improvement and delivery best practice
Build & maintain strong client relationships throughout the project lifecycle
Support & contribute to successful programme and portfolio delivery

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

You'll be an experienced Project Manager with a proven track record of delivering complex projects within secure or highly regulated environments. You'll have excellent leadership and stakeholder management skills, alongside the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining focus on quality, governance and client outcomes.

Essential Qualifications

Significant experience delivering complex projects or programmes
Strong project leadership and stakeholder management skills
Experience managing project budgets, resources, suppliers and delivery plans
Good knowledge of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery methodologies
Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
Strong risk, issue, dependency and change management experience
Experience working within structured governance and reporting frameworks

Desirable Qualifications

PRINCE2, MSP, APM or equivalent project management certification
Experience within Policing, Central Government, Emergency Services or Telecommunications
Experience delivering projects within secure or mission-critical environments
