jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Offensive Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Why Citi

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Why This Team

The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) is home to deeply talented colleagues that work to ensure the safety of Citi's clients', our revenue, our employees and our proprietary data. We manage information security as one end-to end program – one with a clear mandate and accountability. Our mission is a program that is fully anchored to modern control and architectural frameworks, is fully aligned with the enterprise architecture of the firm and is deeply integrated into the businesses and functions.

About The Role

Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) team is hiring practitioners who can run security assessments against AI systems and use AI-powered tools to make security testing faster and more effective.

The AI Offensive Security Analyst is an operational role on a team that runs penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, and Red Team adversarial evaluations across Citi's application portfolio. The AI dimension is twofold: you'll test AI systems as a target, and you'll use AI tools as part of how you work. We're looking for someone to help build the tools from scratch and who knows how to get the most out of them, knows their limits, and can operate in an environment where the right approach isn't always obvious yet.

What Makes This Different

The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet.

AI-driven vulnerability management. When frontier models can generate thousands of findings in a weekend, the bottleneck shifts from discovery to triage, verification, and remediation. We're building the pipeline that makes this sustainable.
Security architecture for the AI era. Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring.
AI at scale, not in a lab. Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job.
Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats. Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale.
Real security engineering. This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful.
Cyber Security Operations — Detection, triage, and response for a world where adversaries use AI to find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than traditional detection can keep up. Behavioral analytics for AI agents. Playbooks for AI-originated attack scenarios.

What You'll Work On

Testing AI applications and agents. GenAI applications, agentic systems, and LLM-backed products require testing that goes beyond standard web app methodology. Prompt injection, indirect injection, retrieval poisoning, tool misuse, sensitive data extraction, unsafe delegation, these are real attack classes with real business impact. You'll design and execute test cases for them.
Using AI to work better. AI-assisted testing changes what's possible in a pen testing engagement: broader coverage, faster reconnaissance, automated validation of common vulnerability classes. You'll be expected to know how to use these capabilities effectively and to help the broader team adopt what works.
Embedding security into development. Working with development teams and security engineers to make sure AI application assessments happen at the right points in the build process.

What We're Looking For

Security Testing Experience

Practical experience running penetration tests or vulnerability assessments against web applications, APIs, or mobile applications. Alternatively, Red Team experience running adversary simulations as an operator
Familiarity with common security testing tools: Burp Suite, nuclei, nmap, or similar
Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and at least some exposure to OWASP LLM Top 10 or MITRE ATLAS
Ability to triage findings and communicate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audience

AI Literacy

Hands-on experience using LLM tools in a meaningful way, whether for security testing, security research, or your own workflows
Enough understanding of how LLMs work (context windows, tool use, RAG, agentic chaining) to reason about where they can go wrong
Familiarity with AI testing tools or frameworks, even from personal research or experimentation, is a real plus: Garak, PyRIT, PromptBench, Inspect AI, or equivalent

General

Comfortable working on problems that don't have a playbook yet
Can write clearly: test plans, findings reports, risk summaries
Curious about the security implications of AI systems, not just the hype around them

Levels

Assistant Vice President (C12 Mid - Senior Level): 5-7+ years. Own workstreams end-to-end with real autonomy. You'll go deep on problems that most organizations don't even know they have yet.
Vice President (C13 Senior - Lead/Staff Level): 8-10+ years. Define technical approach, make architectural decisions, mentor others. The scope here is wider than most senior IC roles — you're not optimizing an existing system; you're designing ones that don't exist yet.
Senior Vice President (C14 Lead/Staff - Principal Level): 10+ years. Set technical direction for a function and influence the firm's approach to AI security. If you've hit a ceiling elsewhere because the problem space isn't big enough, it's big enough here.

Why Citi, Why Now

Real and urgent. Not an innovation lab. The threats are active, the work ships into production, and it protects one of the world's largest financial institutions.
Technical teams. These are engineering-led functions. Small teams, high autonomy, minimal governance overhead. We build tools, ship code, and measure ourselves by what we deliver — not slide decks.
Strong mandate. Executive sponsorship to move fast. You'll have the backing and resources to act on what you find.
Unique scope. Very few organizations operate at this intersection at this scale. The solutions you build will influence how the industry responds.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Master’s degree preferred

We offer

By joining Citi, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:

27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
A discretional annual performance related bonus
Private Medical Care & Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pension Plan
Paid Parental Leave
Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
Access to an array of learning and development resources

Visit our Global Benefits page to learn more.

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay and empowered to thrive.

Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities

The role sits within Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) organization, a team whose mission is to safeguard Citi's clients, partners, and business sectors by integrating an attacker's mindset across the technology lifecycle.

We have multiple openings across various experience levels, from senior to principal, offering a dynamic environment for growth and impact. Location and compensation packages may be flexible and will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Intelligence Operations Analyst
to play a pivotal role in providing actionable intelligence to support cyber operations. This position demands a keen understanding of cyber threats, trends, and tactics, as well as the ability to analyze and synthesize complex data from various sources. This position requires understanding and execution of intelligence support to offensive cyberspace operations. The analyst will collaborate closely with cyber operations teams to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risks, ensuring the protection and resilience of critical network infrastructure.

Utilizing established analytical tradecraft and Department of War Intelligence Cycle gathers and analyzes all data which provides intelligence support to cyberspace operations. Support will span full-spectrum (offense and defense) cyberspace operations and will enable: planning; target system analysis; collection management; coordination of intelligence community production; intelligence gap analysis; adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures; threat analysis of Mission Relevant Terrain – Cyber or Cyber Key Terrain; target development; and intelligence requirements development.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Conduct in-depth analysis of cyber threat intelligence, including emerging malware, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors.
Collect, evaluate, and fuse intelligence from diverse sources, including open-source intelligence (OSINT), signals intelligence (SIGINT), human intelligence (HUMINT), and technical intelligence (TECHINT). Identify correlations and patterns to enhance situational awareness and predictive analysis.
Assess the potential impact of cyber threats on network infrastructure and operations. Collaborate with cyber defense teams to develop and implement mitigation strategies and countermeasures.
Provide intelligence support during cyber incident response activities, including analysis of indicators of compromise (IOCs), attribution of cyber-attacks, and identification of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Prepare and deliver clear and concise intelligence products, including reports, briefings, and presentations, for a diverse audience, including senior leadership, operational stakeholders, and technical teams.
Foster collaboration and information sharing with internal and external stakeholders, including other intelligence agencies, law enforcement, industry partners, and allied nations, to enhance cyber threat awareness and response capabilities.
Stay abreast of emerging cyber threats, technologies, and methodologies through continuous research and professional development. Contribute to the development of new analytical techniques, tools, and processes to improve intelligence analysis and cyber defense capabilities.
Conduct target system analysis to support entity of interest for offensive cyberspace operations, coordinate for intelligence production and analysis to support advance technical development for offensive operations.
Execute collection management drawing subordinate unit intelligence requirements and overseeing their progress through the various means of collection to resolve intelligence gaps.
Develop Targets through Advanced Target development to achieve vetted and validated COCOM level targets for mission package execution.
Maintain various mission profile intelligence documentation requirements to support execution offensive cyberspace operations.

jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
HEICO is seeking a Threat and Vulnerability Management Analyst for a full time direct hire on-site role in Hollywood, FL.

ROLE:
The Threat and Vulnerability Management Analyst
is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and coordinating the remediation of security weaknesses across HEICO’s applications, endpoints, networks, and cloud environments. This role acts as a critical link between threat intelligence and the systems teams executing remediation. In addition to standard vulnerability management, this position proactively validates external defenses through security configuration testing and monitors for sensitive data exposure to ensure a robust overall data security posture.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Scanning & Identification

Run regular vulnerability scans across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
Configure, maintain, and tune scanning tools to ensure accurate coverage and minimize false positives.

Data Security & Access Monitoring

Monitor for excessive or inappropriate access to sensitive data and verify compliance with data protection standards; collaborate with the GRC and Compliance functions to ensure findings are tracked and remediated appropriately.
Assess data flows and access permissions to identify over-privileged accounts and potential data exposure risks.

Active Defense Validation & Testing

Conduct targeted external penetration and security configuration tests to validate the strength of perimeter defenses; penetration testing tools are used primarily to validate vulnerability scan results rather than conduct full-scope red-team engagements.
Replicate common threat actor techniques to identify and document exploitable paths within the infrastructure.

Analysis & Prioritization

Triage incoming vulnerability reports, threat intelligence feeds, and security testing findings.
Analyze risks using severity metrics combined with internal business context to prioritize remediation efforts.

Remediation Coordination

Collaborate closely with IT, DevOps, and systems administrators to guide, track, and validate patching and configuration hardening efforts.
Assist in organizing patch cycles and developing response plans for zero-day vulnerabilities.

Reporting & Tracking

Generate executive and technical dashboards tracking remediation progress, vulnerability aging, and team KPIs.
Maintain up-to-date documentation on vulnerability standards, exception requests, and remediation playbooks.

REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Experience:

Minimum two (2) to four (4) years of dedicated experience in cybersecurit
y, with a strong focus on threat and vulnerability management.
Hands-on experience with industry-standard vulnerability scanners (such as Tenable Nessus, Qualys, or Rapid7) and cloud security platforms.
Direct experience performing security validation using standard penetration testing tools (such as Metasploit, OWASP ZAP, or Burp Suite) primarily to validate scan findings and confirm exploitability — not as a full-scope red-team practitioner.
Familiarity with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms (such as LightBeam) and data loss prevention methodologies.
Familiarity with risk frameworks (CVSS, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, or OWASP).
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical vulnerabilities and configuration issues into clear, actionable business risks for non-security teams.

Desired Qualifications:

Proficiency with Python or PowerShell to automate reporting and scanning tasks.
Experience managing vulnerabilities within containerized environments (Kubernetes/Docker) and cloud-native workloads.
Exposure to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) or Operational Technology (OT) networks.
Professional certifications such as CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, CEH, or similar.

This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need.

What You’ll Do

Research & Analysis

Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players
Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers
Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis
Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services

Client Engagement & Business Development

Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance
Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services
Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends
Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers

Global Collaboration

Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership
Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments

What You Bring

We’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles:

IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market
Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions
Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles

Skills & Qualifications

Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan
English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan
Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word
Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team)
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.
A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.

Onboarding and reviewing log sources into the SOC/SIEM, and validating cyber incident alerts.

What they are looking for

6 years’ experience as a cybersecurity analyst/engineer
Hands-on experience with Microsoft security platforms (Entra AD, AD Admin, level)

Job Description

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

The Role

We are seeking a Research Analyst for our Investment Grade Structured Products Research Team, primarily covering CLOs, and over time select ABS sectors. We are looking for an individual who will combine in-depth research coverage with well-developed relative value skills to deliver value across a range of strategies in our taxable bond funds.

The Value You Deliver

Provide thorough fundamental analysis and research coverage of assigned sectors
Communicate credit opinions and relative value views through published research as well as in-person meetings
Generate investment ideas across your coverage in a timely and well-communicated manner, as well as respond to investment opportunities in the market
Participate in regular discussions on investment strategy and contribute to the ongoing development of the investment process
Become an integral part of the investment team serving a range of fixed income investment mandates with attention to holdings across the Fixed Income bond funds and sensitivity to the differences in mandates
Work with investment professionals across Fidelity globally, including members of the equity, high income and alternatives and asset allocation teams
Collaborate in a heavily team-based investment process
Maintain strong relationships with issuers, rating agencies, and analysts while also traveling regularly
Provide strong mentorship of, and close collaboration with, junior members of the research team in support of the research team and investment process

At Fidelity, Research Analysts make recommendations that have significant impact on the funds. You will become a highly valued core member of the research and investment teams (which include portfolio managers, traders and quantitative analysts), actively participating with portfolio managers and traders in strategy sessions that address credit trends and asset allocation. The analytical work requires regular issuer contact, travel, and working together with and mentoring Sector Specialists who provide analytical and data support. You will report to the Managing Director of Research for Financials and Structured Products.

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

The ideal candidate will have the following qualifications and attributes:

Five years or more experience as a fixed income analyst covering CLOs, with current or prior experience covering ABS strongly preferred
Demonstrated success making fixed income investment recommendations
Strong analytical and technology skills
Critical thinking
Excellent oral and written communication
Good time management
Flexibility and skill in handling the demands of a broad and diverse coverage load
Ability to think creatively, work collaboratively and make decisions quickly, often with limited information
An ability to engage proactively with portfolio managers, traders and quantitative analysts
The ability to develop and present investment ideas and investment information in a clear and effective way
A high level of enthusiasm for discovering and responding to new investment opportunities
Progress towards a CFA or an MBA is preferred
The confidence and the maturity to lead meetings internally and externally
Exhibit the highest level of personal and professional integrity

The Group

Fidelity’s Fixed Income division is one of the leading managers of bond and money market instruments with over $2 trillion in fixed income assets. The Fixed Income team combines fundamental research on domestic and international debt issuers with macroeconomic and quantitative analysis to develop investment decisions that stay true to each portfolio’s defined investment mandate, while aiming to maximize risk-adjusted total return for our clients. Our goal is to use our financial expertise to help people achieve their financial goals and live the lives they want. The Fixed Income division is headquartered / located primarily in Merrimack, New Hampshire, one hour north of Boston.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

jobs.description:
Description

Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraud among hundreds of millions of e-Commerce transactions in different countries? What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online? What kinds of processes and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Come be a part of a rapidly expanding Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations (TSE Ops) team that helps solve this challenging problem at scale.

The Team: The Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations (TSE Ops) works on improving seller experience and overall ensuring that Amazon’s marketplace is a safe and trusted space for our customers by enabling activities in different scopes, such as: Product Safety and Compliance (PSC), Restricted Products (RP), Product Quality (PQ) and Trusted Order and Remediation Experience (TORX). In addition to these, the team has support functions which enable the investigator and operational experience through workforce and capacity planning, ops analytics, site strategy, program expansion, change management, tech enablement and security and compliance. The team supports 16 languages across 21 Amazon stores with over 8K employees located in 17 sites.

Role : We are looking for a Sr Program Manager to support the Trust worthy Shopping experience (TSE) Operations & Product team. The role holder will look at opportunities within the TSE space that can be unified and done centrally, thereby helping deliver cost savings. The role holder will need to partner with program teams to understand their needs and evaluate opportunities for standardization and automation. And partner with Operations team for seamless execution.

The right candidate is highly organized, can look out for potential opportunities, earn trust with partner teams and also have a tech bent of mind for automation. Also the role holder is required to have the ability to evangelize the idea to multiple partner teams, have a strong ability to communicate effectively (both orally and in written form) and have experience influencing without authority. You are a strategic thinker with a proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership, planning both for the short-and long term, and successfully delivering results with limited guidance.

Key job responsibilities

Drive SOP standardization by partnering with Program stakeholders.
Evaluate and drive opportunities to drive SOP automation to improve speed and accuracy of the investigators.
Ensure that the Ops investigators have a seamless experience across functions, working with product and tech teams to own and fix workflow issues.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
5+ years of program or project management experience
5+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

The AI & Business Intelligence Program Manager leads the end-to-end execution of data strategy and AI initiatives across Tripadvisor’s Travel Experiences. Job Location: Hybrid

Deliver Operational Momentum: Maintain project management rigor across data pipelines, predictive search features, dynamic pricing models, and AI support systems—tracking milestones and holding dependencies accountable.
Translate Data into Strategy: Partner with CX and Product leadership to convert traveler behavior data and BI reporting into actionable operational changes that reduce friction across the booking and trip lifecycle.
Unblock Technical & Organizational Friction: Proactively identify bottlenecks in data availability, BI tool integrations, or cross-team alignment, delivering clear resolution paths before project schedules slip.

Qualifications

Experience: 4–6 years of program management experience leading technical AI, business intelligence, or data strategy initiatives.
BI & AI Competency: Strong command of business intelligence frameworks, visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau), SQL, and practical understanding of AI/ML lifecycles (including Generative AI and predictive modeling).
Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to manage complex technical roadmaps involving data engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Executive Communication: Exceptional talent for synthesizing data-heavy technical concepts into compelling, structured updates for non-technical executives.
Domain Empathy: Deep interest in online travel, marketplace dynamics, and traveler journey optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in travel tech, e-commerce marketplaces, or consumer-facing digital platforms.
Certifications in program management (PMP, CSM) or advanced credentials in Business Intelligence / Data Strategy.

Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses

Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

You will lead cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on scope, schedule, and the designs follow the project and client specifications and standards. The projects this person will be engaged on will encompass a variety of unique challenges and innovative solutions due to their varying sizes, scopes, and complexities. AI and Innovation

Develop and manage detailed tool-level installation schedules, ensuring critical path milestones are met to support the client’s "First Tool" and "Ready for Equipment" (RFE) dates.

Maintain strict control over project budgets, managing change orders related to tool configuration shifts and ensuring procurement of long-lead infrastructure components aligns with the installation sequence.

Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with utility capacity, seismic bracing, and vibration isolation requirements for sensitive process equipment.
Follows established change management procedures to document and receive authorization for project change orders in a timely manner.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging lessons learned to optimize project delivery methodologies and enhance client satisfaction.
Offer mentorship and training to fellow Project Managers, sharing insights on resolving intricate design challenges in high technology and industrial design projects, both at SSOE and client sites.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related technical discipline preferred).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions.

SSOE offers a competitive total compensation package designed to support and empower our employees and their families.

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Electrification – Power Transformers | Stafford, United Kingdom

Do you want to lead complex, high-value projects that help power the future of energy transmission around the world?

GE Vernova is looking for an experienced Lead Project Manager to join our HVDC Power Transformers team based in Stafford, United Kingdom.

GE Vernova – The Energy to Change the World

With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.

Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.

Electrification

Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.

Let’s Talk About the Role

As Lead Project Manager, you will take ownership of complex, high-value HVDC transformer projects from project handover through to final delivery and customer acceptance.

You will manage multiple projects or transformer packages concurrently, with accountability for their operational and financial performance. Working within a global matrix organisation, you will lead cross-functional teams spanning engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, logistics and other key functions.

You will bring these teams together to deliver projects safely and in accordance with agreed quality, cost and schedule commitments. As a trusted point of contact for customers, you will balance commercial rigour with technical delivery, helping to protect project outcomes while strengthening customer relationships and GE Vernova’s reputation for excellence.

This is a project leadership position without formal direct reports. Your success will depend on your ability to influence, coordinate and lead multidisciplinary project resources across the wider organisation.

How You Will Make a Difference

Take ownership of HVDC transformer projects from formal project handover through to delivery and customer acceptance.
Lead multiple projects or equipment packages concurrently, establishing clear plans, priorities, milestones and accountabilities.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, quality, logistics and other supporting functions.
Manage project financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, costs and margin within the assigned scope.
Develop and maintain project schedules, delivery plans and contingency or recovery actions.
Monitor project scope and contractual commitments, ensuring that changes and their commercial or delivery implications are understood and appropriately managed.
Drive the effective management of risks and opportunities, identifying potential issues early and implementing suitable mitigation actions.
Act as a key point of contact for customers, maintaining clear communication and building strong, lasting relationships.
Facilitate project and gate reviews, ensuring that actions, decisions and accountabilities are clearly documented and followed through.
Provide accurate and timely reporting on project progress, costs, risks and overall performance.
Work with internal teams, customers and suppliers to resolve complex technical, commercial and delivery challenges.
Promote a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance and continuous improvement throughout project execution.
Capture lessons learned and use them to strengthen future project delivery.

Special Role Requirements

Occasional travel, including international travel, may be required to support project delivery and customer engagement.

Skills for Success

You will be a confident, organised communicator with a strong record of delivering complex projects. You will bring:

Significant experience managing complex, high-value, customer-facing engineering, equipment or manufacturing projects.
Experience taking ownership of projects from contract or internal handover through to delivery and customer acceptance.
Strong financial and commercial awareness, including experience managing project budgets, costs, forecasts and financial performance.
Practical knowledge of project risk, opportunity, change and issue management.
Experience coordinating and leading multidisciplinary teams within a matrix organisation.
The ability to manage multiple projects, work packages or competing priorities concurrently.
Strong customer and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to communicate across technical, commercial and senior-leadership audiences.
The ability to analyse complex information, exercise sound judgement and drive issues through to resolution.
Strong written and spoken English; additional language skills would be advantageous.
Confidence using project-management, reporting and documentation systems.

A degree in Electrical Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline would be advantageous. However, we are most interested in your overall project-delivery experience, professional achievements and practical expertise.

Experience delivering transformers, HVDC systems, power-transmission infrastructure or other high-value engineered equipment would be particularly valuable. We would also welcome relevant experience gained within other technically complex sectors.

A recognised project-management qualification, such as APM, PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent certification, would also be advantageous.

Where and How You’ll Work

This is a permanent position based at our Stafford facility.

We operate a hybrid working model, with an expectation that you will normally work from the Stafford site three days per week and from home for the remaining two days.

The position follows standard business hours and is not a shift-based role. Occasional travel may be required, although this is expected to be limited.

Our Culture

Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.

Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate-change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.

Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, join us and be the difference. Together, we have the Energy to Change the World.

We’re Determined to Be the Best Place to Grow

We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you with the tools to navigate and shape a career journey that supports a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you throughout your journey.

We also prioritise fair pay, performance-based rewards and wellbeing programmes for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can continue evolving while sustainability remains at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we help inspire others to grow, succeed and raise the bar for everyone.

As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to supporting disadvantaged groups while providing equal opportunities for GE Vernova colleagues and applicants alike.

Join us at GE Vernova, where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

Additional Information

Help us tackle the growing wildfire crisis with the latest advancements in AI and IoT

Who We Are

The challenge:
Every minute matters in wildfire response. As climate change increases the frequency and intensity of wildfires—with longer fire seasons, drier fuels, and more extreme weather—new ignitions can spread rapidly, putting communities, critical infrastructure, and ecosystems at risk. Today, many wildfires are first reported by members of the public
, meaning it can take valuable time to detect a fire, confirm its location and size, and mobilize responders
. Fire agencies
need faster, more reliable ways to detect, verify, and pinpoint new ignitions so they can respond quickly and prevent small fires from becoming catastrophic events.

About Pano AI:
Pano AI is the leader in AI-powered wildfire detection and intelligence, helping fire professionals detect, respond to, and contain wildfires faster and more safely. Our platform combines advanced hardware, software, artificial intelligence, satellite imagery, and other data sources to provide real-time situational awareness and actionable intelligence. Using a network of ultra-high-definition, 360-degree cameras positioned across high vantage points, Pano AI delivers a real-time view of wildfire activity, enabling faster, more informed decision-making when every second counts.

We are a team of more than 175 people working in a hybrid-remote environment across North America and Australia
, with headquarters in San Francisco. Our customers include government agencies, utilities, insurers, and private landowners
who rely on Pano AI to help protect people, property, and natural landscapes. Pano AI currently serves customers across the United States, Australia, and Canada
, monitoring more than 50 million acres worldwide.

Our values are part of everything we do at Pano AI. They guide how we work together, how we serve our customers, and how we approach our mission.

Impact:
As we scale our business, we grow our impact—enabling emergency managers to protect people, infrastructure, and the environment from devastating wildfires.

Service:
We serve those who serve, and the teammates beside us.

Trust:
We earn trust through integrity, accountability, and an obsession with quality so that our partners can rely on us.

Excellence and Speed:
We produce exceptional work quickly because our mission demands both precision and urgency.

Innovation:
We apply cutting-edge technology to what we build and how we work.

Our work has been recognized by Fast Company as one of the Top 10 Most Innovative AI Companies in 2023 and one of the World's Most Innovative Companies in 2026, ranking #1 in Sustainability. We have also been named to TIME's list of the 100 Most Influential Companies of 2025 and recognized by MIT Technology Review as one of the top climate technology companies to watch.

Backed by $89 million in funding from leading investors including Giant Ventures, Liberty Mutual Ventures, Tokio Marine Future Fund, Congruent Ventures, Initialized Capital, Salesforce Ventures, and T-Mobile Ventures, we're building technology that helps communities around the world become more resilient to wildfire. Learn more at www.pano.ai
.

The Role

Pano AI is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of complex cross-functional programs across our engineering, product, and operations teams. As a Senior TPM, you will be the connective tissue between our squads—ensuring that ambitious technical initiatives ship on time, risks are surfaced early, and every team has what they need to move fast. You will work across our Software, Embedded, and Hardware teams to drive programs from discovery through delivery, and play a key role in maturing our program management practices as we scale.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the heart of Pano’s engineering organization. You will partner directly with engineering leads, product managers, and design—and have a direct line to senior leadership on program status and risk. If you are energized by bringing order to complexity, thrive in fast-moving startup environments, and care deeply about building technology that saves lives, we’d love to meet you.

What you'll do

Own end-to-end program management for complex, multi-team technical initiatives—from scoping and planning through execution, launch, and retrospective
Partner with engineering leads, product managers, and designers to define program milestones, map dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress, risks, and decisions
Drive sprint planning, quarterly roadmap planning, and OKR processes, ensuring teams have clear priorities, realistic timelines, and well-defined success criteria
Build and maintain program dashboards, status reports, and roadmap views that provide leadership and cross-functional partners with real-time visibility into delivery health
Identify and resolve blockers proactively—driving escalations, facilitating decisions, and removing friction across teams before they become schedule threats
Lead cross-functional working groups and recurring program syncs, ensuring the right people are engaged and every meeting drives toward a clear, documented outcome
Support the engineering organization in building scalable processes, tooling, and ceremonies as we grow from 150 to 300+ people
Collaborate with external partners—including fire agencies, government entities, and utility companies—to coordinate program dependencies and joint deliverables
Champion engineering team health: track capacity, flag burnout risks, and advocate for sustainable pacing without sacrificing velocity

What you'll bring

7+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related field at a fast-paced technology company or startup
Proven track record of managing large-scale, cross-functional technical programs with multiple concurrent workstreams, competing priorities, and diverse stakeholders
Strong technical fluency—comfortable engaging with engineering teams on system architecture, APIs, platform integrations, and sprint-level planning
Expertise in Agile and Scrum methodologies; hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Linear, or equivalent project management platforms
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical topics for executive and non-technical audiences, and to write crisp status reports and decision documents

High emotional intelligence and relationship-building skills—you build trust quickly across engineering, product, design, and business teams

new_jobs.description:
About the Role:

At Ferrero, protecting our people, our brands and our business is fundamental to how we operate.

As Security Manager UK&I, you will lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of our security strategy across the UK and Ireland, working closely with Group Security and senior stakeholders across the business. With a remit spanning our manufacturing sites, offices, warehouses, Head Office and wider business operations, this is a broad and influential security leadership role.

Taking a holistic and risk-based approach, you will be responsible for helping protect our people, physical assets, goods, critical processes and organisational know-how, balancing effective risk mitigation with commercial awareness and operational practicality.

This is much more than a traditional site security role. Your remit will span security intelligence, physical and logistical security, executive protection, travel security, incident and crisis management, investigations, due diligence, security training, and threat and risk assessment.

As a trusted adviser to UK&I leadership, you will assess an evolving risk landscape, ensure emerging threats and vulnerabilities are understood and appropriately escalated, and translate complex security risks into proportionate, practical solutions for the business.

Main Responsibilities:

You will lead the implementation and continuous improvement of Ferrero's Security Management System across UK&I, ensuring alignment with Group standards while responding to the specific risk profile and operational requirements of the local business.

You will develop and maintain security, emergency response and crisis management plans, alongside programmes covering physical security, information protection, incident management, travel security and executive protection.

A key part of your role will be monitoring and assessing the external threat landscape, including crime, terrorism, workplace violence, geopolitical and travel risks, natural or man-made disruption and emerging security threats, translating intelligence into appropriate action for the business.

You will lead and support sensitive internal investigations involving matters such as theft, fraud, conflicts of interest, bribery, loss of assets and unauthorised disclosure of proprietary information, working with relevant internal functions and external authorities where appropriate.

You will oversee physical security projects from initial risk assessment and technical requirements through to implementation, coordinating internal stakeholders, suppliers and contractors and ensuring effective management of scope, timelines, budgets and delivery.

Working closely with Supply Chain, you will support an effective logistics security programme designed to protect raw materials and finished goods across domestic and international movements.

You will manage UK&I security CAPEX and OPEX budgets
, including forecasting, cost control and variance management, ensuring investment decisions remain aligned with identified risks and business priorities.

Building strong relationships will be fundamental to the role. You will partner with UK&I leadership, Plant Management, Supply Chain, P&O, Risk Management, Finance and Group Security, while also maintaining appropriate external networks with law enforcement, intelligence and security organisations.

You will also lead security awareness and training initiatives, strengthening security capability across the organisation and ensuring our people understand the role they play in protecting themselves, their colleagues and the business.

About You:

You will be an established security professional with experience operating across a complex corporate, multi-site or similarly demanding environment, bringing the credibility and judgement required to influence at senior level.

You will have strong knowledge across areas including corporate and physical security, threat and risk assessment, investigations, crisis and incident management, and security intelligence, with the ability to understand how different areas of security risk connect across an organisation.

Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, you will be equally confident advising senior leaders on significant or emerging risks and ensuring security programmes, controls and projects are successfully delivered operationally.

You will bring strong judgement, integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive matters, alongside the ability to remain calm, assess information quickly and make sound decisions in complex or rapidly developing situations.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills are essential, together with the ability to build effective relationships across different functions, locations and levels of seniority.

You will also bring strong project and financial management capability, ideally including experience managing security suppliers, significant physical security projects and CAPEX/OPEX budgets.

If you are a security leader who combines strong technical expertise with commercial judgement, stakeholder influence and the ability to turn risk insight into action, this is an opportunity to shape security capability and resilience across Ferrero UK&I and help us continue to protect what matters most – our people, our business and our brands.

What We Offer:

Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here.

Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946.
Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands
sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.

As a trusted partner to our military customers, HII designs, develops and operates the largest LVC enterprise that prepares warfighters for cross-domain battle. For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants and aircraft carriers—HII ensures a high state of readiness.

HII supports the Department of Energy’s national security mission through the management and operation of its sites, as well as the safe cleanup of legacy waste across the country. HII meets clients’ toughest nuclear and environmental challenges.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

Mission Technologies, a division of HII, is seeking an experienced Industrial Security Analyst to support ongoing SCIF/SAPF renovation, infrastructure modernization, and Protected Distribution System (PDS) integration initiatives at the Joint Integrated Test and Training Center – Nellis (JITTC-N) supporting the 31 CTS at Nellis AFB, NV.

This position will serve as the primary Site Security Manager (SSM) and Construction Security representative for renovation and infrastructure projects associated with the JITTC-N campus mission environments. The role will directly support phased modernization efforts involving facility upgrades, secure communications infrastructure, PDS implementation, and transition toward co-use SCIF/SAPF environments in accordance with ICD/ICS 705 requirements. The selected candidate will work in close coordination with the Physical Security Lead for construction security synchronization, accreditation support, and integration of physical security requirements throughout all phases of renovation and modernization activities, while reporting directly to the Physical Security Lead for overall project execution, milestone coordination, and operational integration efforts and will support synchronization between Industrial Security, Physical Security, Civil Engineering, Communications, Program Management, Facilities, and operational stakeholders to ensure security compliance is maintained throughout all phases of construction and modernization efforts.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Serve as the Site Security Manager (SSM) for SCIF/SAPF renovation, modernization, and classified construction activities.
Coordinate closely with the Physical Security Lead to support construction security oversight, project synchronization, milestone tracking, and accreditation-related activities, project execution, renovation coordination, operational integration efforts, deliverables, and milestone status updates.
Maintain and enforce Construction Security Plans (CSPs) supporting ICD 705 compliance requirements.
Support planning and coordination efforts associated with Protected Distribution System (PDS) implementation and secure infrastructure modernization.
Apply working knowledge of CNSSI No. 7003 requirements related to Protected Distribution Systems (PDS), secure transmission pathways, inspection requirements, and physical protection standards for classified communications infrastructure.
Review project drawings, Statements of Work (SOW), facility layouts, and construction packages impacting classified environments.
Support accreditation documentation efforts associated with ICD 705 upgrades, co-use facility requirements, and phased construction activities.
Assist with development and coordination of SOPs, interim operational procedures, and risk mitigation strategies during active renovation and infrastructure integration efforts.
Monitor classified construction activities and ensure compliance with applicable ICD/ICS 705, CNSSI 7003, NISPOM, and customer-specific security requirements.
Conduct construction security oversight, document security incidents/violations, maintain construction security records, and support inspection activities.
Participate in project meetings, facility walkthroughs, site surveys, risk assessments, milestone tracking, and cross-functional project synchronization efforts.
Support long-term campus modernization initiatives involving secure communications pathways, classified infrastructure integration, and co-use SCIF/SAPF accreditation strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

6 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 10 years relevant experience.
Specialized Training Requirement: The selected candidate will be required to complete an approved Site Security Manager (SSM) training plan to bring the member up to the fully required specialized construction security experience level within one (1) year of hire.
Client requirements: Minimum 5+ years of Industrial Security experience supporting DoD/DoW or Intelligence Community programs.
Demonstrated experience supporting Intelligence Community Directive (ICD)/ Intelligence Community Standard (ICS) 705 Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF),/Special Access Program Facilities (SAPF), construction, renovation, or accreditation projects.
Working knowledge of Committee on National Security Systems Instruction (CNSSI) No. 7003 Protected Distribution System (PDS) requirements.
Experience developing or managing Construction Security Plans (CSPs).
Working knowledge of construction processes, infrastructure modernization efforts, facility renovations, or Civil Engineering project environments.
Familiarity with project drawings, facility modification packages, and construction coordination processes.

new_jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Offensive Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Why Citi

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Why This Team

The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) is home to deeply talented colleagues that work to ensure the safety of Citi's clients', our revenue, our employees and our proprietary data. We manage information security as one end-to end program – one with a clear mandate and accountability. Our mission is a program that is fully anchored to modern control and architectural frameworks, is fully aligned with the enterprise architecture of the firm and is deeply integrated into the businesses and functions.

About The Role

Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) team is hiring practitioners who can run security assessments against AI systems and use AI-powered tools to make security testing faster and more effective.

The AI Offensive Security Analyst is an operational role on a team that runs penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, and Red Team adversarial evaluations across Citi's application portfolio. The AI dimension is twofold: you'll test AI systems as a target, and you'll use AI tools as part of how you work. We're looking for someone to help build the tools from scratch and who knows how to get the most out of them, knows their limits, and can operate in an environment where the right approach isn't always obvious yet.

What Makes This Different

The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet.

AI-driven vulnerability management. When frontier models can generate thousands of findings in a weekend, the bottleneck shifts from discovery to triage, verification, and remediation. We're building the pipeline that makes this sustainable.
Security architecture for the AI era. Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring.
AI at scale, not in a lab. Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job.
Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats. Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale.
Real security engineering. This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful.
Cyber Security Operations — Detection, triage, and response for a world where adversaries use AI to find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than traditional detection can keep up. Behavioral analytics for AI agents. Playbooks for AI-originated attack scenarios.

What You'll Work On

Testing AI applications and agents. GenAI applications, agentic systems, and LLM-backed products require testing that goes beyond standard web app methodology. Prompt injection, indirect injection, retrieval poisoning, tool misuse, sensitive data extraction, unsafe delegation, these are real attack classes with real business impact. You'll design and execute test cases for them.
Using AI to work better. AI-assisted testing changes what's possible in a pen testing engagement: broader coverage, faster reconnaissance, automated validation of common vulnerability classes. You'll be expected to know how to use these capabilities effectively and to help the broader team adopt what works.
Embedding security into development. Working with development teams and security engineers to make sure AI application assessments happen at the right points in the build process.

What We're Looking For

Security Testing Experience

Practical experience running penetration tests or vulnerability assessments against web applications, APIs, or mobile applications. Alternatively, Red Team experience running adversary simulations as an operator
Familiarity with common security testing tools: Burp Suite, nuclei, nmap, or similar
Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and at least some exposure to OWASP LLM Top 10 or MITRE ATLAS
Ability to triage findings and communicate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audience

AI Literacy

Hands-on experience using LLM tools in a meaningful way, whether for security testing, security research, or your own workflows
Enough understanding of how LLMs work (context windows, tool use, RAG, agentic chaining) to reason about where they can go wrong
Familiarity with AI testing tools or frameworks, even from personal research or experimentation, is a real plus: Garak, PyRIT, PromptBench, Inspect AI, or equivalent

General

Comfortable working on problems that don't have a playbook yet
Can write clearly: test plans, findings reports, risk summaries
Curious about the security implications of AI systems, not just the hype around them

Levels

Assistant Vice President (C12 Mid - Senior Level): 5-7+ years. Own workstreams end-to-end with real autonomy. You'll go deep on problems that most organizations don't even know they have yet.
Vice President (C13 Senior - Lead/Staff Level): 8-10+ years. Define technical approach, make architectural decisions, mentor others. The scope here is wider than most senior IC roles — you're not optimizing an existing system; you're designing ones that don't exist yet.
Senior Vice President (C14 Lead/Staff - Principal Level): 10+ years. Set technical direction for a function and influence the firm's approach to AI security. If you've hit a ceiling elsewhere because the problem space isn't big enough, it's big enough here.

Why Citi, Why Now

Real and urgent. Not an innovation lab. The threats are active, the work ships into production, and it protects one of the world's largest financial institutions.
Technical teams. These are engineering-led functions. Small teams, high autonomy, minimal governance overhead. We build tools, ship code, and measure ourselves by what we deliver — not slide decks.
Strong mandate. Executive sponsorship to move fast. You'll have the backing and resources to act on what you find.
Unique scope. Very few organizations operate at this intersection at this scale. The solutions you build will influence how the industry responds.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Master’s degree preferred

We offer

By joining Citi, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:

27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
A discretional annual performance related bonus
Private Medical Care & Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pension Plan
Paid Parental Leave
Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
Access to an array of learning and development resources

Visit our Global Benefits page to learn more.

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay and empowered to thrive.

Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities

The role sits within Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) organization, a team whose mission is to safeguard Citi's clients, partners, and business sectors by integrating an attacker's mindset across the technology lifecycle.

Whether you're defining requirements for enterprise applications, data initiatives, or customer experience programs, your work directly influences what gets built and how successfully it performs in the real world.

Many of our clients rely on sophisticated data and payment processes that require a high degree of accuracy and accountability. Perform root cause analysis on data and process issues to help teams identify effective solutions.
Support payment validation and data accuracy initiatives where precision is critical.

Support new business discussions and client presentations when business knowledge is needed.
Help improve analysis practices, templates, and delivery processes across teams.

5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst delivering complex technology or data solutions in client-facing environments.
5+ years of experience working within Agile delivery teams.
Strong SQL skills with the ability to analyze and interpret complex data.
Experience gathering requirements across application development, data, and user experience initiatives.
Proven ability to lead stakeholder discussions and translate business needs into actionable requirements.
Experience reviewing large datasets, performing root cause analysis, and solving complex business problems.

new_jobs.description:
Amentum has an opportunity for a highly qualified Cyber
Intelligence Operations Analyst
to play a pivotal role in providing actionable intelligence to support cyber operations. This position demands a keen understanding of cyber threats, trends, and tactics, as well as the ability to analyze and synthesize complex data from various sources. This position requires understanding and execution of intelligence support to offensive cyberspace operations. The analyst will collaborate closely with cyber operations teams to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risks, ensuring the protection and resilience of critical network infrastructure.

Utilizing established analytical tradecraft and Department of War Intelligence Cycle gathers and analyzes all data which provides intelligence support to cyberspace operations. Support will span full-spectrum (offense and defense) cyberspace operations and will enable: planning; target system analysis; collection management; coordination of intelligence community production; intelligence gap analysis; adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures; threat analysis of Mission Relevant Terrain – Cyber or Cyber Key Terrain; target development; and intelligence requirements development.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Conduct in-depth analysis of cyber threat intelligence, including emerging malware, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors.
Collect, evaluate, and fuse intelligence from diverse sources, including open-source intelligence (OSINT), signals intelligence (SIGINT), human intelligence (HUMINT), and technical intelligence (TECHINT). Identify correlations and patterns to enhance situational awareness and predictive analysis.

new_jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
HEICO is seeking a Threat and Vulnerability Management Analyst for a full time direct hire on-site role in Hollywood, FL.

ROLE:
The Threat and Vulnerability Management Analyst
is responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and coordinating the remediation of security weaknesses across HEICO’s applications, endpoints, networks, and cloud environments. This role acts as a critical link between threat intelligence and the systems teams executing remediation. In addition to standard vulnerability management, this position proactively validates external defenses through security configuration testing and monitors for sensitive data exposure to ensure a robust overall data security posture.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Scanning & Identification

Run regular vulnerability scans across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
Configure, maintain, and tune scanning tools to ensure accurate coverage and minimize false positives.

Data Security & Access Monitoring

Monitor for excessive or inappropriate access to sensitive data and verify compliance with data protection standards; collaborate with the GRC and Compliance functions to ensure findings are tracked and remediated appropriately.
Assess data flows and access permissions to identify over-privileged accounts and potential data exposure risks.

Active Defense Validation & Testing

Conduct targeted external penetration and security configuration tests to validate the strength of perimeter defenses; penetration testing tools are used primarily to validate vulnerability scan results rather than conduct full-scope red-team engagements.
Replicate common threat actor techniques to identify and document exploitable paths within the infrastructure.

Analysis & Prioritization

Triage incoming vulnerability reports, threat intelligence feeds, and security testing findings.
Analyze risks using severity metrics combined with internal business context to prioritize remediation efforts.

Remediation Coordination

Collaborate closely with IT, DevOps, and systems administrators to guide, track, and validate patching and configuration hardening efforts.
Assist in organizing patch cycles and developing response plans for zero-day vulnerabilities.

Reporting & Tracking

Generate executive and technical dashboards tracking remediation progress, vulnerability aging, and team KPIs.
Maintain up-to-date documentation on vulnerability standards, exception requests, and remediation playbooks.

REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Experience:

Minimum two (2) to four (4) years of dedicated experience in cybersecurit
y, with a strong focus on threat and vulnerability management.
Hands-on experience with industry-standard vulnerability scanners (such as Tenable Nessus, Qualys, or Rapid7) and cloud security platforms.
Direct experience performing security validation using standard penetration testing tools (such as Metasploit, OWASP ZAP, or Burp Suite) primarily to validate scan findings and confirm exploitability — not as a full-scope red-team practitioner.
Familiarity with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms (such as LightBeam) and data loss prevention methodologies.
Familiarity with risk frameworks (CVSS, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, or OWASP).
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical vulnerabilities and configuration issues into clear, actionable business risks for non-security teams.

Desired Qualifications:

Proficiency with Python or PowerShell to automate reporting and scanning tasks.
Experience managing vulnerabilities within containerized environments (Kubernetes/Docker) and cloud-native workloads.
Exposure to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) or Operational Technology (OT) networks.
Professional certifications such as CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, CEH, or similar.
