Overview

If you've spent time studying or working outside Japan and you're ready to put that global perspective to work, this role was built for you. Japan's IT services market is one of the most complex and distinctive in the world — and IDC needs analysts who can read it from the inside while connecting it to what's happening globally. That combination is rare, and it's exactly what makes this role compelling.

About The Role

This is an opportunity to shape how the world understands Japan's IT services market — and to do it from Tokyo, at the center of one of Asia-Pacific's most dynamic technology ecosystems.

As a Research Analyst on IDC Japan's Services team, you will lead original research on Japan's IT services landscape, with a particular focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and domestic local vendors that define much of the market's character. You will contribute to two flagship IDC programs — the Japan Services CIS program and the Worldwide Semiannual Services Tracker — and collaborate closely with IDC's global and Asia-Pacific analyst network.

This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need.

What You’ll Do

Research & Analysis

Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players
Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers
Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis
Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services

Client Engagement & Business Development

Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance
Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services
Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends
Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers

Global Collaboration

Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership
Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments

What You Bring

We’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles:

IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market
Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions
Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles

Skills & Qualifications

Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan
English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan
Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word
Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.

What We Offer

Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy.
Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team)
Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day.

Job Description

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

Business process and data understanding

Develop a detailed understanding of how Fund Accounting data is created, enriched, transformed, reviewed, reconciled, approved, and consumed.
Work with Fund Accounting, Data Governance, and Data Product Management to define business problems, intended outcomes, priorities, users, business rules, data ownership, and acceptance criteria.
Identify sources of truth, data owners, business definitions, transformation points, downstream consumers, dependencies, controls, and process handoffs.
Analyze current-state processes and data flows to identify manual work, duplicate logic, data issues, control gaps, and standardization opportunities.

Requirements And Business Rules

Translate Fund Accounting needs into clear business, data, integration, reporting, and broader consumption requirements for the appropriate delivery teams.
Define field definitions, measures, calculations, dimensions, filters, hierarchies, business rules, mappings, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes.
Partner with Data Governance and Data Product Management on data ownership, definitions, quality expectations, lineage, control requirements, prioritization, and decision records.
Develop source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, process flows, requirements, and traceability artifacts in collaboration with the teams responsible for implementation.
Frame requirements clearly enough for the Finance Technology Data Solutions Engineer, Enterprise Data Engineering, Centralized Reporting / BI, and application teams to design, build, test, and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.

Data investigation, reconciliation, and testing

Use SQL and structured analysis to profile data, compare sources, identify anomalies, trace records, quantify breaks, and support root-cause analysis.
Perform field-level and aggregate analysis to distinguish source, transformation, reference-data, integration, and reporting issues.
Partner with Fund Accounting, Data Governance, Data Product Management, engineering, and reporting teams to define validation rules, tolerances, exception categories, ownership, and remediation expectations.
Develop and execute reconciliation, integration, regression, edge-case, reporting, and production-validation test scenarios as part of the broader delivery team.
Create repeatable queries and validation packs that can be reused by the broader team.

Reporting And Broader Data Consumption Requirements

Understand the business question, intended consumers, decisions supported, frequency, level of detail, and delivery channel for each consumption need.
Define requirements for dashboards, reports, extracts, downstream applications, operational workflows, analytics, and other ways Fund Accounting consumes data and derives value from it.
Identify governed sources of truth and document measures, calculations, dimensions, filters, business rules, refresh expectations, control expectations, reconciliation needs, and validation criteria.
Convey agreed business requirements to Centralized Reporting / BI, which owns the technical build and delivery of scalable dashboards and reporting solutions using governed data.
Coordinate Fund Accounting review, business validation, UAT, release readiness, and post-production validation for reporting and other consumption solutions.

Delivery and stakeholder partnership

Act as the bridge between Fund Accounting business teams and Finance Technology while preserving important business and technical detail.
Coordinate with Data Product Management, Data Governance, the Finance Technology Data Solutions Engineer, Enterprise Data Engineering, Centralized Reporting / BI, application teams, and delivery partners throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Maintain traceability from the original business problem through requirements, design, testing, release, and validation of the delivered outcome.
Communicate issues clearly, including affected users and data, business impact, evidence, decisions needed, and recommended next steps.
Help convert recurring manual investigation into prioritized backlog items and governed, reusable, scalable data or consumption solutions.

Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

Experience Required:
3 to 8 years in a technical data analyst, data-focused business analyst, financial data, accounting technology, or similar role in a controlled enterprise environment.

Must-have Capabilities

Strong SQL for profiling, joins, aggregations, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis, preferably in SQL Server.
Advanced Excel for structured analysis, including lookups, pivots, formulas, comparisons, and controlled validation workbooks.
Experience defining business, data, reporting, and consumption requirements; mappings; measures; calculations; business rules; acceptance criteria; and test cases.
Hands-on data-quality analysis, reconciliation, defect investigation, testing, business validation, and UAT.
Ability to understand data models, ETL/ELT flows, APIs or file interfaces, reporting layers, and dependencies across source, data, and consumption layers.
Ability to work effectively with Fund Accounting, Data Product Management, Data Governance, Finance Technology engineering, Enterprise Data Engineering, Centralized Reporting / BI, and application teams.

Strongly Preferred

Databricks, Python, PySpark, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or similar platforms.
Fund Accounting, asset management, investor data, fund administrator, financial reporting, or investment operations experience.
Working knowledge of accounting balances, transactions, capital activity, reference data, hierarchies, controls, and period-end processes.
Experience defining requirements for dashboards, reports, extracts, downstream applications, operational workflows, or analytics.
Exposure to delivery tooling, structured defect triage, release management, lineage, metadata, governance, and auditability concepts.

How Success Will Be Measured

Business, data, reporting, and consumption requirements are clear, complete, testable, and aligned to business objectives.
Data issues are identified and resolved faster through repeatable analysis, clear evidence, and coordinated ownership.
Reconciliation, testing, business validation, and UAT produce reliable delivery outcomes.
Fund Accounting consumption needs are translated into governed, scalable solutions delivered through the appropriate Finance Technology, enterprise data, reporting, or application team.
Strong collaboration, traceability, and handoffs are established across the broader data and reporting operating model.

Reporting Relationships

Vice President, Head of Engineering - Secondaries Technology

new_jobs.title: Fixed Income Research Analyst, Structured Products
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

The Role

We are seeking a Research Analyst for our Investment Grade Structured Products Research Team, primarily covering CLOs, and over time select ABS sectors. We are looking for an individual who will combine in-depth research coverage with well-developed relative value skills to deliver value across a range of strategies in our taxable bond funds.

The Value You Deliver

Provide thorough fundamental analysis and research coverage of assigned sectors
Communicate credit opinions and relative value views through published research as well as in-person meetings
Generate investment ideas across your coverage in a timely and well-communicated manner, as well as respond to investment opportunities in the market
Participate in regular discussions on investment strategy and contribute to the ongoing development of the investment process
Become an integral part of the investment team serving a range of fixed income investment mandates with attention to holdings across the Fixed Income bond funds and sensitivity to the differences in mandates
Work with investment professionals across Fidelity globally, including members of the equity, high income and alternatives and asset allocation teams
Collaborate in a heavily team-based investment process
Maintain strong relationships with issuers, rating agencies, and analysts while also traveling regularly
Provide strong mentorship of, and close collaboration with, junior members of the research team in support of the research team and investment process

At Fidelity, Research Analysts make recommendations that have significant impact on the funds. You will become a highly valued core member of the research and investment teams (which include portfolio managers, traders and quantitative analysts), actively participating with portfolio managers and traders in strategy sessions that address credit trends and asset allocation. The analytical work requires regular issuer contact, travel, and working together with and mentoring Sector Specialists who provide analytical and data support. You will report to the Managing Director of Research for Financials and Structured Products.

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

The ideal candidate will have the following qualifications and attributes:

Five years or more experience as a fixed income analyst covering CLOs, with current or prior experience covering ABS strongly preferred
Demonstrated success making fixed income investment recommendations
Strong analytical and technology skills
Critical thinking
Excellent oral and written communication
Good time management
Flexibility and skill in handling the demands of a broad and diverse coverage load
Ability to think creatively, work collaboratively and make decisions quickly, often with limited information
An ability to engage proactively with portfolio managers, traders and quantitative analysts
The ability to develop and present investment ideas and investment information in a clear and effective way
A high level of enthusiasm for discovering and responding to new investment opportunities
Progress towards a CFA or an MBA is preferred
The confidence and the maturity to lead meetings internally and externally
Exhibit the highest level of personal and professional integrity

The Group

Fidelity’s Fixed Income division is one of the leading managers of bond and money market instruments with over $2 trillion in fixed income assets. The Fixed Income team combines fundamental research on domestic and international debt issuers with macroeconomic and quantitative analysis to develop investment decisions that stay true to each portfolio’s defined investment mandate, while aiming to maximize risk-adjusted total return for our clients. Our goal is to use our financial expertise to help people achieve their financial goals and live the lives they want. The Fixed Income division is headquartered / located primarily in Merrimack, New Hampshire, one hour north of Boston.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

Certifications

Investment Professionals

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT BAYGI GROUP BayGi Group is a hospitality and real estate development company focused on creating distinctive hotel and resort destinations across Vietnam, with long-term ambitions for regional expansion throughout Asia.
The Group focuses on hospitality development, resort operations, hotel management, and integrated real estate projects. Our approach combines strategic site selection, commercial discipline, thoughtful positioning, and hands-on operational execution.
Our objective is to create hospitality experiences that meet international standards while delivering sustainable financial performance and long-term asset value.
THE OPPORTUNITY BayGi Group is seeking a Business Analyst
to support the evaluation, planning, and development of a resort project in Nha Trang
, alongside other hospitality and real estate initiatives within the Group.
The role provides direct exposure to the commercial, financial, and investment aspects of resort development, including market research, feasibility analysis, financial modelling, competitive benchmarking, and project evaluation.
You will work closely with BayGi Group's leadership team and contribute directly to real investment, development, and strategic decisions.
ROLE DETAILS • Full-time position
• On-site / Hybrid depending on project requirements
• Direct exposure to senior management and project leadership
• Salary: 15,000,000 – 20,000,000 VND per month
, depending on experience and capabilities
• Opportunities for career progression as BayGi Group expands its hospitality and real estate portfolio
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Conduct market research and competitive analysis for a resort development project in Nha Trang
• Analyze the Nha Trang and broader coastal hospitality market, including hotel and resort supply, demand, positioning, pricing, and competitive performance
• Support feasibility studies and commercial assessments for new hotel and resort opportunities
• Develop and maintain financial models, including revenue projections, operating costs, profitability, break-even analysis, and investment scenarios
• Analyze hospitality performance indicators including ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, GOP margins, and other operating metrics
• Support the evaluation of project positioning, room mix, facilities, pricing strategy, and potential revenue streams
• Prepare structured financial spreadsheets, market reports, and internal reporting dashboards
• Support the preparation of investment memoranda, feasibility presentations, and strategic materials for management
• Assist leadership in evaluating potential development, acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities
• Translate financial and market data into clear, practical recommendations for management
REQUIREMENTS • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong Excel skills, including the ability to build and maintain financial models
• Good understanding of finance, accounting, investment, real estate, or business principles
• Ability to interpret financial, commercial, and operational data
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
• Strong attention to detail and commercial awareness
PREFERRED • Academic background in Business, Finance, Real Estate, Hospitality, Economics, or a related discipline
• Experience in financial modelling, investment analysis, or feasibility studies
• Familiarity with hospitality KPIs and hotel economics
• Understanding of real estate development or hospitality investment
• Previous experience in consulting, finance, real estate, hospitality, investment, or startups
WHAT YOU WILL GAIN • Direct involvement in a real resort development and investment project in Nha Trang
• Hands-on experience in hospitality investment, development, and commercial analysis
• Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making
• Experience conducting market studies and evaluating development and investment opportunities
• Practical experience in financial modelling and feasibility analysis
• Exposure to the full lifecycle of hotel and resort development, from initial evaluation through planning and execution
• Opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement as BayGi Group expands its portfolio
APPLICATION Please submit:
• CV / Resume
• Academic transcript, if available
GIỚI THIỆU VỀ BAYGI GROUP BayGi Group là công ty hoạt động trong lĩnh vực phát triển bất động sản và khách sạn, tập trung xây dựng các điểm đến nghỉ dưỡng và khách sạn khác biệt tại Việt Nam, với định hướng dài hạn mở rộng hoạt động ra khu vực châu Á.
Tập đoàn tập trung vào phát triển dự án khách sạn và khu nghỉ dưỡng, vận hành resort, quản lý khách sạn và các dự án bất động sản tích hợp. Phương pháp của BayGi Group kết hợp giữa lựa chọn vị trí chiến lược, kỷ luật tài chính, định vị sản phẩm phù hợp và năng lực vận hành thực tế.
Mục tiêu của chúng tôi là phát triển những sản phẩm lưu trú đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, đồng thời tạo ra hiệu quả tài chính bền vững và gia tăng giá trị tài sản trong dài hạn.
CƠ HỘI NGHỀ NGHIỆP BayGi Group đang tìm kiếm Chuyên viên Phân tích Kinh doanh (Business Analyst)
để hỗ trợ quá trình đánh giá, hoạch định và phát triển một dự án khu nghỉ dưỡng tại Nha Trang
, đồng thời tham gia vào các dự án khách sạn, nghỉ dưỡng và bất động sản khác của Tập đoàn.
Vị trí này mang đến cơ hội trực tiếp tham gia vào các khía cạnh thương mại, tài chính và đầu tư của quá trình phát triển resort, bao gồm nghiên cứu thị trường, phân tích tính khả thi, xây dựng mô hình tài chính, phân tích đối thủ cạnh tranh và đánh giá dự án.
Bạn sẽ làm việc trực tiếp với đội ngũ lãnh đạo BayGi Group và đóng góp vào các quyết định đầu tư, phát triển và chiến lược thực tế.
THÔNG TIN VỊ TRÍ • Nhân viên toàn thời gian
• Làm việc trực tiếp / Hybrid tùy theo nhu cầu của dự án
• Làm việc trực tiếp với đội ngũ quản lý và lãnh đạo dự án
• Mức lương: 15.000.000 – 20.000.000 VND/tháng
, tùy theo kinh nghiệm và năng lực
• Có cơ hội thăng tiến khi BayGi Group mở rộng danh mục dự án khách sạn và bất động sản
NHIỆM VỤ CHÍNH • Thực hiện nghiên cứu thị trường và phân tích cạnh tranh cho dự án phát triển khu nghỉ dưỡng tại Nha Trang
• Phân tích thị trường khách sạn và nghỉ dưỡng tại Nha Trang và các thị trường du lịch ven biển liên quan, bao gồm nguồn cung, nhu cầu, định vị, mức giá và hiệu quả hoạt động của đối thủ
• Hỗ trợ thực hiện nghiên cứu khả thi và đánh giá thương mại cho các cơ hội phát triển khách sạn và khu nghỉ dưỡng mới
• Xây dựng và duy trì các mô hình tài chính, bao gồm dự phóng doanh thu, chi phí vận hành, lợi nhuận, phân tích điểm hòa vốn và các kịch bản đầu tư
• Phân tích các chỉ số vận hành khách sạn như ADR, RevPAR, tỷ lệ lấp đầy, biên lợi nhuận GOP và các chỉ số liên quan
• Hỗ trợ đánh giá định vị dự án, cơ cấu loại phòng, tiện ích, chiến lược giá và các nguồn doanh thu tiềm năng
• Chuẩn bị các bảng tính tài chính, báo cáo nghiên cứu thị trường và dashboard phục vụ công tác quản lý nội bộ
• Hỗ trợ chuẩn bị bản ghi nhớ đầu tư, báo cáo nghiên cứu khả thi và các bài thuyết trình chiến lược cho ban lãnh đạo
• Hỗ trợ đội ngũ lãnh đạo đánh giá các cơ hội phát triển dự án, mua lại tài sản, hợp tác và đầu tư
• Chuyển hóa dữ liệu tài chính và thị trường thành các đề xuất rõ ràng và thực tiễn cho ban quản lý
YÊU CẦU • Kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt
• Thành thạo Excel và có khả năng xây dựng, duy trì mô hình tài chính
• Có hiểu biết tốt về tài chính, kế toán, đầu tư, bất động sản hoặc kinh doanh
• Có khả năng đọc hiểu và phân tích dữ liệu tài chính, thương mại và vận hành
• Kỹ năng giao tiếp bằng văn bản và lời nói rõ ràng

• Chú trọng chi tiết và có tư duy thương mại
ƯU TIÊN • Có nền tảng học thuật về Kinh doanh, Tài chính, Bất động sản, Khách sạn, Kinh tế hoặc lĩnh vực liên quan

• Có kinh nghiệm làm việc hoặc thực tập trong lĩnh vực tư vấn, tài chính, bất động sản, khách sạn, đầu tư hoặc startup

new_jobs.title: CX Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Our Client
Aretum is a mission-driven organization providing innovative, technology-enabled solutions across the defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, the organization helps government agencies address critical challenges while fostering collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth.
About the Opportunity
The CX Research Analyst
conducts research and analysis to understand stakeholder needs, behaviors, and experiences. This role applies customer experience research methods, strategic communications, and stakeholder engagement to translate insights into actionable recommendations that improve products, services, and overall user experiences.
Responsibilities
• Conduct stakeholder interviews, surveys, and user research to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities.
• Develop customer journey maps and experience assessments to identify pain points and areas for improvement.
• Analyze product and service data to evaluate customer experience and identify meaningful trends.
• Engage internal and external stakeholders to gather feedback and support customer-focused initiatives.
• Prepare research findings, recommendations, presentations, and communications to inform leadership and support strategic decision-making.
• Apply customer experience research and performance insights to recommend improvements.
• Facilitate discussions and stakeholder sessions to gather qualitative and quantitative insights.
• Support the development and implementation of customer experience improvement initiatives.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience supporting customer experience, service design, or organizational improvement initiatives in government, consulting, or large enterprise environments.
• Ability to use customer experience research and performance data to influence strategy and decision-making.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraud among hundreds of millions of e-Commerce transactions in different countries? What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online? What kinds of processes and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Come be a part of a rapidly expanding Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations (TSE Ops) team that helps solve this challenging problem at scale.

The Team: The Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations (TSE Ops) works on improving seller experience and overall ensuring that Amazon’s marketplace is a safe and trusted space for our customers by enabling activities in different scopes, such as: Product Safety and Compliance (PSC), Restricted Products (RP), Product Quality (PQ) and Trusted Order and Remediation Experience (TORX). In addition to these, the team has support functions which enable the investigator and operational experience through workforce and capacity planning, ops analytics, site strategy, program expansion, change management, tech enablement and security and compliance. The team supports 16 languages across 21 Amazon stores with over 8K employees located in 17 sites.

Role : We are looking for a Sr Program Manager to support the Trust worthy Shopping experience (TSE) Operations & Product team. The role holder will look at opportunities within the TSE space that can be unified and done centrally, thereby helping deliver cost savings. The role holder will need to partner with program teams to understand their needs and evaluate opportunities for standardization and automation. And partner with Operations team for seamless execution.

The right candidate is highly organized, can look out for potential opportunities, earn trust with partner teams and also have a tech bent of mind for automation. Also the role holder is required to have the ability to evangelize the idea to multiple partner teams, have a strong ability to communicate effectively (both orally and in written form) and have experience influencing without authority. You are a strategic thinker with a proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership, planning both for the short-and long term, and successfully delivering results with limited guidance.

Key job responsibilities

Drive SOP standardization by partnering with Program stakeholders.
Evaluate and drive opportunities to drive SOP automation to improve speed and accuracy of the investigators.
Ensure that the Ops investigators have a seamless experience across functions, working with product and tech teams to own and fix workflow issues.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
5+ years of program or project management experience
5+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
